hero.title: पुर्तगाली: अफोंसो डी अल्बुकर्क
hero.description: अफोंसो डी अल्बुकर्क के गवर्नर कार्यकाल (1509-1515), पूर्व में पुर्तगाली साम्राज्य के वास्तविक संस्थापक, गोवा, मलक्का और होर्मुज की विजय, अंतर-विवाह की नीति, और सती प्रथा के उन्मूलन जैसे सामाजिक सुधारों पर महारत हासिल करें।

timeline.title: अफोंसो डी अल्बुकर्क का गवर्नर कार्यकाल और प्रभाव
timeline.description: भारत में अल्बुकर्क के प्रशासन के तहत प्रमुख ऐतिहासिक मील के पत्थर।

cards.details: राजा मैनुअल प्रथम के निर्देशों के बाद, अल्मेडा द्वारा कैद से रिहा किए जाने के बाद अल्बुकर्क ने गवर्नर के रूप में पदभार संभाला।
स्थानीय हिंदू निजी नाविक तिम्मैया (टिमोजा) की सहायता से बीजापुर के सुल्तान यूसुफ आदिल शाह से गोवा छीन लिया।
मलक्का सल्तनत पर विजय प्राप्त की, जिससे हिंद महासागर को दक्षिण चीन सागर से जोड़ने वाले एक रणनीतिक चोक पॉइंट को सुरक्षित किया गया।
फारस की खाड़ी में होर्मुज (Ormuz) के रणनीतिक किले को सुरक्षित किया, जिससे हिंद महासागर के व्यापार मार्गों की घेराबंदी पूरी हो गई।
राजा मैनुअल प्रथम द्वारा बर्खास्त किए जाने के बाद गोवा के तट पर मृत्यु हो गई। उन्हें गोवा में दफनाया गया, वे अपने पीछे एक मजबूत नौसैनिक साम्राज्य छोड़ गए।

traps.title: सामान्य यूपीएससी परीक्षा के जाल
items: जाल 1: वास्तविक संस्थापक बनाम प्रथम वायसराय: फ्रांसिस्को डी अल्मेडा (पहले वायसराय) को अफोंसो डी अल्बुकर्क के साथ भ्रमित न करें। अल्मेडा पहले वायसराय थे, लेकिन क्षेत्रीय अधिग्रहण के कारण अल्बुकर्क को भारत में पुर्तगाली सत्ता का **वास्तविक संस्थापक** माना जाता है।

जाल 2: गोवा पर विजय की तिथि: गोवा को पहली बार 1510 की शुरुआत में लिया गया था, कुछ समय के लिए बीजापुर को वापस खो दिया गया था, और **नवंबर 1510** में स्थायी रूप से फिर से कब्जा कर लिया गया था। सुनिश्चित करें कि कालानुक्रमिक क्रम सटीक है।

जाल 3: सती प्रथा उन्मूलन का कालक्रम: 1829 में विलियम बेंटिंक द्वारा पूरे ब्रिटिश भारत में सती प्रथा को प्रतिबंधित करने से सदियों पहले अल्बुकर्क द्वारा 1510 में गोवा में सती प्रथा को प्रतिबंधित कर दिया गया था। क्षेत्रीय पुर्तगाली प्रतिबंध को अखिल भारतीय ब्रिटिश कानून के साथ भ्रमित न करें।

sections.title: 1. नियुक्ति, उत्तराधिकार विवाद और पदभार ग्रहण (1509)
sections.content:
उत्तराधिकार के लिए संघर्ष: अफोंसो डी अल्बुकर्क 1508 के अंत में भारत पहुंचे, वे अपने साथ राजा के गुप्त दस्तावेज लाए थे जिसमें उन्हें फ्रांसिस्को डी अल्मेडा के बाद अगला गवर्नर नामित किया गया था। हालाँकि, चोल के युद्ध में अपने बेटे लॉरेंको की मृत्यु से अत्यंत दुखी अल्मेडा ने पद छोड़ने से इनकार कर दिया। अल्मेडा ने अल्बुकर्क के दस्तावेजों की वैधता पर सवाल उठाया और उन्हें कोचीन के फोर्ट मैनुअल में कैद कर दिया। अल्बुकर्क ने नवंबर 1509 में पुर्तगाल के मार्शल फर्नांडो कौटिन्हो के नेतृत्व में एक पुर्तगाली बेड़े के आगमन तक कई महीने कैद में बिताए। कौटिन्हो ने राजा के आदेशों को लागू किया, अल्बुकर्क को मुक्त कराया, और अल्मेडा को सत्ता सौंपने और प्रस्थान करने के लिए मजबूर किया।

साम्राज्य की रणनीति का नया रूप: अल्बुकर्क के कार्यभार संभालने से अल्मेडा की नीले पानी की नीति (ब्लू वाटर पॉलिसी) में भारी बदलाव आया। जहां अल्मेडा केवल समुद्री वर्चस्व पर केंद्रित थे, वहीं अल्बुकर्क ने महसूस किया कि एक स्थायी जमीनी उपस्थिति अनिवार्य थी। उन्होंने एक मिश्रित प्रादेशिक-नौसैनिक मॉडल का समर्थन किया जहां पुर्तगाल सीधे हिंद महासागर के प्रमुख प्रवेश बिंदुओं पर रणनीतिक किलों और बंदरगाहों पर कब्जा करेगा। इस रणनीति का उद्देश्य एस्टाडो दा इंडिया को केवल व्यापारिक चौकियों के संग्रह से एशिया में एक संप्रभु प्रादेशिक साम्राज्य में बदलना था।

masteryZone.q: In which fortress of कोचीन was Afonso de अल्बुकर्क imprisoned by Francisco de अल्मेडा?
masteryZone.sol: अल्मेडा imprisoned अल्बुकर्क in फोर्ट मैनुअल to delay handing over the governorship.

masteryZone.q: Which Portuguese Marshal arrived in कोचीन in November 1509 to enforce the succession rights of अल्बुकर्क?
masteryZone.sol: मार्शल फर्नांडो कौटिन्हो enforced the royal orders of राजा मैनुअल प्रथम to free and install अल्बुकर्क.

masteryZone.q: अल्बुकर्क's strategic vision marked a shift from अल्मेडा's नीले पानी की नीति (ब्लू वाटर पॉलिसी) to which model?
masteryZone.sol: अल्बुकर्क realized naval patrols alone were insufficient and established fortified territorial bases.

masteryZone.q: Who was the Portuguese King who issued secret credentials to अल्बुकर्क to succeed अल्मेडा in 1508?
masteryZone.sol: राजा मैनुअल प्रथम signed the directives for अल्बुकर्क's governorship.

masteryZone.q: What was Francisco de अल्मेडा's primary justification for refusing to yield power to अल्बुकर्क?
masteryZone.sol: Grief-stricken by his son's death at Chaul, अल्मेडा claimed अल्बुकर्क's credentials were not fully valid.
opts: Loss of his son Lourenço at Chaul and doubts over patents
A treaty signed with the Zamorin

masteryZone.q: Which of the following elements characterized the succession dispute between अल्मेडा and अल्बुकर्क? (Select all that apply)
masteryZone.sol: अल्मेडा imprisoned अल्बुकर्क and questioned his papers until Marshal Coutinho arrived. Bijapur was not involved.
opts: Imprisonment of अल्बुकर्क in फोर्ट मैनुअल
Sultan of Bijapur mediating the dispute
अल्मेडा questioning the credentials from राजा मैनुअल प्रथम

masteryZone.q: What were the limitations of the नीले पानी की नीति (ब्लू वाटर पॉलिसी) that अल्बुकर्क sought to fix? (Select all that apply)
masteryZone.sol: Patrolling without bases led to ship wear, lack of funds, and vulnerability of leased factories. Spices were authorized.
opts: Lack of repair docks for cruiser fleets
Vulnerability of leased trading factories to local rulers
High costs of continuous patrols without local tax bases
Lack of authorization to trade in spices

masteryZone.q: Identify the key individuals present in कोचीन during the transition of power in November 1509. (Select all that apply)
masteryZone.sol: अल्मेडा, अल्बुकर्क, and Marshal Coutinho were key figures. Saint Francis Xavier arrived decades later.

masteryZone.q: Which of the following strategic views did अल्बुकर्क hold? (Select all that apply)
masteryZone.sol: He advocated for chokepoints, fortresses, and intermarriages, not abandoning naval power.
opts: Control of major maritime choke points is essential
Establishment of permanent land-based fortresses in Asia
Mixed marriages to build a loyal colonial population
Abandonment of all naval warfare in favor of foot soldiers

masteryZone.q: What factors delayed the recognition of अल्बुकर्क as governor? (Select all that apply)
masteryZone.sol: अल्मेडा's Diu campaign, his grief over Lourenço, and shipping delays allowed the succession dispute to drag on.
opts: The Battle of Diu campaign by अल्मेडा
अल्मेडा's deep personal grief over his son's death
Rejection of अल्बुकर्क by the कोचीन Raja
Communication lag between Lisbon and कोचीन

masteryZone.q: सत्य या असत्य: Francisco de अल्मेडा willingly handed over charge to अल्बुकर्क upon his arrival in late 1508.
masteryZone.sol: अल्मेडा refused and imprisoned अल्बुकर्क in फोर्ट मैनुअल.

masteryZone.q: सत्य या असत्य: Marshall Fernando Coutinho died shortly after enforcing अल्बुकर्क's succession during a failed raid in Calicut.
masteryZone.sol: Coutinho led a disastrous attack on Calicut in early 1510 and was killed, leaving अल्बुकर्क in sole command.

masteryZone.q: सत्य या असत्य: अल्बुकर्क agreed with अल्मेडा that Portuguese power should remain purely naval.
masteryZone.sol: अल्बुकर्क championed a territorial empire with land-based fortifications.

masteryZone.q: सत्य या असत्य: फोर्ट मैनुअल, where अल्बुकर्क was confined, was situated in कोचीन.
masteryZone.sol: फोर्ट मैनुअल was the main Portuguese stronghold in कोचीन prior to the conquest of गोवा.

masteryZone.q: सत्य या असत्य: The succession dispute lasted for nearly a year between late 1508 and late 1509.
masteryZone.sol: अल्बुकर्क remained in custody or sidelined from December 1508 to November 1509.

masteryZone.q: सत्य या असत्य: राजा मैनुअल प्रथम sent Marshal Coutinho specifically because he anticipated resistance from अल्मेडा.
masteryZone.sol: The Crown sent Coutinho with a powerful fleet to resolve any administrative resistance and secure the Spice Route.

masteryZone.q: सत्य या असत्य: अल्मेडा's नीले पानी की नीति (ब्लू वाटर पॉलिसी) focused on controlling territory rather than shipping routes.
masteryZone.sol: अल्मेडा's policy focused on naval patrol of trade routes, avoiding expensive land bases.

masteryZone.q: सत्य या असत्य: अल्बुकर्क arrived in India in late 1508 with the rank of Viceroy.
masteryZone.sol: He arrived as a designated Governor; अल्मेडा was the only official Viceroy at the time.

masteryZone.q: अल्बुकर्क was held in captivity inside Fort __________ in कोचीन.
masteryZone.sol: He was imprisoned in फोर्ट मैनुअल by अल्मेडा.

masteryZone.q: The Portuguese king who planned the strategic transition from अल्मेडा to अल्बुकर्क was __________.
masteryZone.sol: राजा मैनुअल प्रथम designed the strategic shift toward direct territorial control.

masteryZone.q: Marshal __________ Coutinho arrived in November 1509 to release अल्बुकर्क.
masteryZone.sol: Fernando Coutinho arrived with royal credentials and a powerful fleet.

masteryZone.q: अल्बुकर्क's plan shifted away from the __________ Water Policy of अल्मेडा.
masteryZone.sol: He abandoned the नीले पानी की नीति (ब्लू वाटर पॉलिसी) in favor of land fortresses.

masteryZone.q: The dispute over power ended in the month of __________ in 1509.
masteryZone.sol: The transition was resolved in November 1509.

masteryZone.q: The Portuguese central administrative system in India was known as the Estado da __________.
masteryZone.sol: The Estado da Índia governed the Portuguese holdings in the Indian Ocean.

masteryZone.q: अल्बुकर्क's designated successor title in the royal credentials was __________ of India.
masteryZone.sol: He was designated as Governor, whereas अल्मेडा was Viceroy.

masteryZone.q: अल्मेडा's son, whose death in battle fueled his grief and anger, was named __________.
masteryZone.sol: Lourenço de अल्मेडा was killed at the Battle of Chaul by a joint Gujarati-Mamluk fleet.

masteryZone.q: मिलान करें historical figures with their respective roles in the 1508-1509 crisis:
masteryZone.sol: अल्मेडा was the first Viceroy, अल्बुकर्क was the designated Governor, and Coutinho was the Marshal.

options.text: First Viceroy who refused to step down

masteryZone.q: मिलान करें Portuguese policies with their defining attributes:
masteryZone.sol: Blue water is naval, territorial is bases, cartaz is ship licenses.

items.left: नीले पानी की नीति (ब्लू वाटर पॉलिसी)

options.text: Licensing pass for merchant ships on trade routes

masteryZone.q: मिलान करें strategic locations of early Portuguese India with their significance:
masteryZone.sol: फोर्ट मैनुअल was the prison, कोचीन was the headquarters, Lisbon was the crown center.

options.text: Early leased Portuguese headquarters in India
Metropolitan center of the Portuguese Crown

masteryZone.q: Who resolved the succession dispute between अल्बुकर्क and अल्मेडा?
masteryZone.sol: मार्शल फर्नांडो कौटिन्हो resolved the dispute in November 1509 by enforcing राजा मैनुअल प्रथम's orders.

masteryZone.q: What was the main difference between अल्मेडा's naval strategy and अल्बुकर्क's strategy?
masteryZone.sol: अल्मेडा preferred naval cruiser warfare (Blue Water), while अल्बुकर्क wanted fortified coastal territories.

masteryZone.q: In which year did अल्बुकर्क officially take office as the Governor of India?
masteryZone.sol: He assumed office in November 1509.

masteryZone.q: What major battle in 1508 caused अल्मेडा to delay his return to Lisbon?
masteryZone.sol: The Battle of Chaul, where his son Lourenço was killed.

masteryZone.q: Which Portuguese king ordered the creation of a territorial empire under अल्बुकर्क?
masteryZone.sol: राजा मैनुअल प्रथम.

masteryZone.q: Why was कोचीन considered an insecure headquarters for the Portuguese before 1510?
masteryZone.sol: It was leased from the local Raja of कोचीन and lacked independent sovereignty, making it vulnerable to Zamorin attacks.

masteryZone.q: What legal document did अल्बुकर्क carry to prove his right to succeed अल्मेडा?
masteryZone.sol: Secret royal credentials (patents of appointment) signed by राजा मैनुअल प्रथम.

masteryZone.q: What happened to Francisco de अल्मेडा shortly after he handed over power and sailed for Portugal?
masteryZone.sol: He was killed in a skirmish with the local Khoikhoi people at Table Bay, South Africa, in 1510.

अभिकथन (A): Marshal Coutinho's death in early 1510 left अल्बुकर्क in sole command.
कारण (R): Coutinho was killed in a failed assault against the Zamorin of Calicut.
masteryZone.sol: Coutinho led a rash attack on Calicut against अल्बुकर्क's advice and was killed, clearing any overlapping authority.
opts: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true

masteryZone.q:
अभिकथन (A): अल्मेडा was imprisoned by अल्बुकर्क in फोर्ट मैनुअल.
कारण (R): अल्बुकर्क wanted to punish अल्मेडा for delaying his assumption of office.
masteryZone.sol: It was अल्बुकर्क who was imprisoned by अल्मेडा, not the other way around.
opts: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true

masteryZone.q:
अभिकथन (A): The transition of power in November 1509 marks the formal beginning of Portuguese territorial imperialism in India.
कारण (R): अल्बुकर्क immediately started planning the conquest of sovereign naval ports.
masteryZone.sol: Taking office allowed अल्बुकर्क to implement his strategic plans for capturing गोवा, मलक्का, and होर्मुज.
opts: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A

masteryZone.q:
निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें: the succession dispute of 1508-1509:
1. Francisco de अल्मेडा imprisoned अल्बुकर्क in फोर्ट मैनुअल.
2. The dispute was resolved only after the arrival of मार्शल फर्नांडो कौटिन्हो.
उपरोक्त कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?
masteryZone.sol: Both statements are correct. अल्मेडा refused to cede power and imprisoned अल्बुकर्क until Coutinho arrived in Nov 1509.

masteryZone.q:
निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें: the early Portuguese strategic shift:
1. अल्मेडा advocated for a sovereign land empire in India.
2. अल्बुकर्क shifted focus to establishing fortified bases at key trade checkpoints.
उपरोक्त कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?
masteryZone.sol: Statement 1 is incorrect because अल्मेडा advocated for naval presence (Blue Water), whereas अल्बुकर्क wanted land bases.

masteryZone.q:
With reference to मार्शल फर्नांडो कौटिन्हो, consider the following statements:
1. He was the Marshal of Portugal sent by राजा मैनुअल प्रथम.
2. He was killed during a military operation against the ruler of Calicut.
उपरोक्त कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?
masteryZone.sol: Both statements are correct. Coutinho enforce succession in कोचीन and died in Calicut in Jan 1510.

masteryZone.q:
निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें: फोर्ट मैनुअल:
1. It was located in Calicut.
2. It served as the prison for अल्बुकर्क during the succession dispute.
उपरोक्त कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?
masteryZone.sol: Statement 1 is incorrect because फोर्ट मैनुअल was built in कोचीन, not Calicut.

masteryZone.q:
निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें: the Portuguese Crown's instructions in 1508:
1. राजा मैनुअल प्रथम wanted to expand trade without territorial expansion.
2. राजा मैनुअल प्रथम issued secret patents nominating अल्बुकर्क as Governor.
उपरोक्त कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?
masteryZone.sol: Statement 1 is incorrect. राजा मैनुअल प्रथम supported अल्बुकर्क's fortress policy to dominate trade through control.

masteryZone.q: Why did Francisco de अल्मेडा refuse to recognize Afonso de अल्बुकर्क's credentials in 1508?
masteryZone.sol: अल्मेडा was grieved by his son's death at Chaul and wanted to conclude his military campaigns himself. He also claimed अल्बुकर्क's patents were signed in secret and lacked full official validation.

masteryZone.q: Why was the नीले पानी की नीति (ब्लू वाटर पॉलिसी) deemed insufficient by Afonso de अल्बुकर्क?
masteryZone.sol: It required continuous maritime patrolling, which caused high ship wear, offered no local shipyards for repairs, and left the Portuguese reliant on vulnerable, leased trade factories.

masteryZone.q: Why did the arrival of मार्शल फर्नांडो कौटिन्हो force अल्मेडा to capitulate?
masteryZone.sol: Coutinho was the Marshal of Portugal and brought a large royal fleet with direct orders from राजा मैनुअल प्रथम. He represented the absolute power of the Crown, which अल्मेडा could not ignore.

masteryZone.q: How did अल्बुकर्क's strategic vision redefine the Portuguese presence in India?
masteryZone.sol: He transformed the Portuguese presence from a mercantile fleet operating under trade licenses into a sovereign territorial power occupying fortified trade bottlenecks.

masteryZone.q: How did the imprisonment of अल्बुकर्क in फोर्ट मैनुअल impact early Portuguese operations?
masteryZone.sol: It stalled administrative and military operations for nearly a year, keeping the Portuguese forces divided until the Crown intervened to install the new governor.

masteryZone.q: How did the death of Lourenço de अल्मेडा affect the transition of power in India?
masteryZone.sol: Lourenço's death at Chaul caused his father, Francisco de अल्मेडा, to focus on revenge, leading to the battle of Diu and his refusal to yield office to अल्बुकर्क.

masteryZone.q: Case Study: The Succession Dispute of कोचीन (1508-1509).
masteryZone.sol: Analyze the institutional friction between the outgoing Viceroy and the incoming Governor, highlighting the role of royal patents, local distance, and military factions.

masteryZone.q: Case Study: Strategic Transition from Naval Patrols to Territorial Bases.
masteryZone.sol: Examine the logistical and economic reasons why अल्बुकर्क chose to establish land fortifications over अल्मेडा's naval patrols.

masteryZone.q: Case Study: Marshal Coutinho's Calicut Campaign and its aftermath.
masteryZone.sol: Examine how Marshal Coutinho's aggressive attack on Calicut led to his death and consolidated अल्बुकर्क's absolute authority as governor.

masteryZone.q: Teach the Concept: The नीले पानी की नीति (ब्लू वाटर पॉलिसी) vs. The Fortress System.
masteryZone.sol: Explain the differences between maintaining naval supremacy through patrolling ships and establishing land-based, sovereign fortified checkpoints to control trade routes.

masteryZone.q: Teach the Concept: Royal Patents and Colonial Autonomy.
masteryZone.sol: Explain how communication lag between Europe and Asia created opportunities for local colonial commanders to act autonomously or delay royal decrees.

masteryZone.q: Teach the Concept: Sovereignty in Early Modern Maritime Trade.
masteryZone.sol: Discuss the difference between leased trade factories (feitorias) and sovereign territorial bases owned outright by a European Crown.

sections.title: 2. गोवा की विजय (1510)
sections.content:
गोवा का रणनीतिक उद्देश्य: 1510 तक, कोचीन में पुर्तगाली मुख्यालय एक जागीरदार शासक से पट्टे पर लिया गया था और क्षेत्रीय संघर्षों के प्रति संवेदनशील था। अल्बुकर्क एक स्वतंत्र, संप्रभु पुर्तगाली आधार चाहते थे। गोवा के पास एक शानदार प्राकृतिक बंदरगाह, जहाज निर्माण यार्ड और उपजाऊ भूमि थी। इसके अलावा, यह अरब/फारस और दक्षिण भारतीय राज्यों (विजयनगर और दक्कन सल्तनतों) के बीच अत्यधिक आकर्षक घोड़ों के व्यापार का एक केंद्रीय केंद्र था। गोवा को नियंत्रित करने का अर्थ दक्षिण भारत के सैन्य संतुलन को नियंत्रित करना था।

1510 का अभियान: मुस्लिम आदिल शाही शासकों को कमजोर करने की इच्छा रखने वाले एक स्थानीय हिंदू निजी नाविक तिम्मैया (टिमोजा) के मार्गदर्शन में, अल्बुकर्क ने फरवरी 1510 में गोवा पर हमला किया। शहर पर शुरू में न्यूनतम प्रतिरोध के साथ कब्जा कर लिया गया था। हालाँकि, बीजापुर के सुल्तान यूसुफ आदिल शाह ने 6,000 सैनिकों के साथ जवाबी हमला किया, जिससे पुर्तगालियों को मई 1510 में पीछे हटने के लिए मजबूर होना पड़ा। इससे विचलित हुए बिना, अल्बुकर्क ने अपनी सेना को मजबूत किया और 25 नवंबर, 1510 को एक आश्चर्यजनक दूसरा हमला किया। पुर्तगालियों ने बीजापुर की सेना को हरा दिया, शहर को सुरक्षित करने के लिए स्थानीय रक्षकों को खदेड़ दिया, और गोवा को पुर्तगाली पूर्वी साम्राज्य की स्थायी, संप्रभु राजधानी के रूप में स्थापित किया।

masteryZone.q: Who was the ruler of Bijapur from whom अल्बुकर्क first captured गोवा in February 1510?
masteryZone.sol: यूसुफ आदिल शाह was the Sultan of Bijapur who ruled गोवा at the time of the initial capture.

masteryZone.q: On which exact date did अल्बुकर्क permanently recapture गोवा during his second assault?
masteryZone.sol: गोवा was permanently captured on November 25, 1510, St. Catherine's Day.

masteryZone.q: Which local Hindu pirate and commander advised अल्बुकर्क to target गोवा instead of Calicut?
masteryZone.sol: तिम्मैया (टिमोजा) was a Hindu privateer who wanted to end Bijapuri control over गोवा and guided the Portuguese.

masteryZone.q: Why was the harbor of गोवा highly valued by अल्बुकर्क?
masteryZone.sol: गोवा possessed a deep-water natural harbor and local shipbuilding yards that sheltered fleets during monsoons.
opts: Excellent natural shipyards and shelter from monsoon winds
Proximity to the Spice Islands of Indonesia

masteryZone.q: What military action did अल्बुकर्क take against the Muslim defenders of गोवा after the November 1510 victory?
masteryZone.sol: अल्बुकर्क ordered a massacre of the Muslim garrison to secure the base and prevent internal rebellion.
opts: Ordered a large-scale massacre to secure the city
Recruited them as the primary cavalry force
Banished them to कोचीन without taking their weapons

masteryZone.q: What were the main reasons for अल्बुकर्क's focus on गोवा? (Select all that apply)
masteryZone.sol: गोवा offered independence, horse trade control, and shipyards. Calicut was ruled by the Zamorin, not located in गोवा.
opts: To secure an independent sovereign base
To control the profitable trade in Arabian horses
To convert the Zamorin of Calicut to Christianity

masteryZone.q: Which of the following events occurred during the campaign for गोवा in 1510? (Select all that apply)
masteryZone.sol: गोवा was captured in Feb, lost in May, and retaken in Nov. अल्बुकर्क did not die in 1510; he died in 1515.
opts: Initial capture in February with little resistance
Withdrawal of Portuguese forces in May due to Bijapuri counter-attack
Permanent capture on November 25 after a bloody battle
अल्बुकर्क's death during the second siege

masteryZone.q: Identify the allies or supporters of अल्बुकर्क during the 1510 conquest. (Select all that apply)
masteryZone.sol: टिमोजा, local Hindus, and विजयनगर supported the Portuguese. Gujarat was hostile.
opts: Local Hindu population seeking relief from Adil Shahi rule
Emperor of विजयनगर, कृष्ण देव राय (diplomatically)

masteryZone.q: What advantages did गोवा have over कोचीन as a headquarters? (Select all that apply)
masteryZone.sol: गोवा was sovereign, had shipyards, and controlled the horse trade. It had a large local population.
opts: It was sovereign Portuguese territory, not leased
It possessed active shipyards for fleet repair
It was centrally located for horse trade networks
It had no local Hindu or Muslim population

masteryZone.q: Which measures did अल्बुकर्क execute immediately after securing गोवा in November 1510? (Select all that apply)
masteryZone.sol: He banned सती, massacred Bijapuri troops, and kept the gauncar system. He excluded Muslim spice traders.
opts: Preserved the traditional village council (gauncar) tax structures
Declared गोवा a free trade port for Muslim traders

masteryZone.q: सत्य या असत्य: The first capture of गोवा in February 1510 was permanent.
masteryZone.sol: The Portuguese were forced to withdraw in May 1510 when यूसुफ आदिल शाह counter-attacked.

masteryZone.q: सत्य या असत्य: तिम्मैया (टिमोजा) served as the chief adviser and privateer guide for अल्बुकर्क's गोवा campaign.
masteryZone.sol: तिम्मैया provided crucial local intelligence and ships to support the conquest.

masteryZone.q: सत्य या असत्य: यूसुफ आदिल शाह, the Sultan of Bijapur, died shortly after the first recapture of गोवा in 1510.
masteryZone.sol: He died in late 1510, which weakened Bijapur's efforts to retake the city.

masteryZone.q: सत्य या असत्य: गोवा became the official capital of the Estado da Índia immediately in 1510.
masteryZone.sol: Although captured in 1510, गोवा formally became the official capital under Governor Nuno da Cunha in 1530.

masteryZone.q: सत्य या असत्य: अल्बुकर्क ordered a complete massacre of both the Hindu and Muslim populations of गोवा after the conquest.
masteryZone.sol: He massacred only the Muslim population to secure the fortress; he spared the Hindu population and reduced their taxes.

masteryZone.q: सत्य या असत्य: अल्बुकर्क rebuilt the fortifications of गोवा immediately after the November conquest.
masteryZone.sol: He strengthened the walls and built a new fortress to protect गोवा from Bijapuri counter-attacks.

masteryZone.q: सत्य या असत्य: The conquest of गोवा in 1510 was achieved with the direct military support of the British Royal Navy.
masteryZone.sol: The British Navy did not exist in India at that time; it was purely a Portuguese operation.

masteryZone.q: सत्य या असत्य: गोवा was valued by the Portuguese because it was a hub for the military horse trade.
masteryZone.sol: गोवा controlled the import of war horses from Arabia and Persia, which were vital for the Deccan rulers.

masteryZone.q: गोवा was captured from the Sultanate of __________.
masteryZone.sol: Bijapur owned गोवा before the Portuguese conquest.

masteryZone.q: The Hindu privateer who guided the Portuguese fleet to गोवा was __________.
masteryZone.sol: तिम्मैया (or टिमोजा) suggested the capture of गोवा.

masteryZone.q: गोवा was permanently captured on November 25, which was the feast day of Saint __________.
masteryZone.sol: St. Catherine's Day was celebrated to commemorate the victory.

masteryZone.q: The Sultan of Bijapur who lost गोवा in February 1510 was __________ Adil Shah.
masteryZone.sol: यूसुफ आदिल शाह was the ruler who died in 1510.

masteryZone.q: The Portuguese were forced to withdraw from गोवा in the month of __________ 1510.
masteryZone.sol: They withdrew in May 1510 due to monsoon and Bijapuri reinforcements.

masteryZone.q: अल्बुकर्क ordered the massacre of गोवा's __________ population after securing the city in November.
masteryZone.sol: He target the Muslim garrison and population to eliminate Bijapuri loyalty.

masteryZone.q: The major military import trade controlled through गोवा was for war __________.
masteryZone.sol: Cavalry horses from the Middle East were the key import.

masteryZone.q: The local revenue collectors preserved by अल्बुकर्क in गोवा were known as __________.
masteryZone.sol: Gauncars were traditional village council heads in गोवा.

masteryZone.q: मिलान करें events of the 1510 गोवा campaign with their respective months:
masteryZone.sol: First capture in February, retreat in May, permanent conquest in November.

options.text: First capture of गोवा by Portuguese

masteryZone.q: मिलान करें groups in गोवा with अल्बुकर्क's post-conquest policy towards them:
masteryZone.sol: Muslims were massacred, Hindus were spared with tax relief, and gauncars were preserved for administration.

masteryZone.q: मिलान करें strategic assets of गोवा with their description:
masteryZone.sol: Harbor provided shelter, shipyards built ships, and horse trade was a trade monopoly.

options.text: Facilities to repair and build caravels
Monopoly over Persian and Arabian cavalry imports

masteryZone.q: Why did अल्बुकर्क order a massacre of the Muslim population in गोवा in November 1510?
masteryZone.sol: To secure the territory from internal rebellion and avenge the betrayal during the Bijapuri counter-attack in May.

masteryZone.q: Which treaty did अल्बुकर्क offer to the Hindu residents of गोवा after the conquest?
masteryZone.sol: He promised them protection, preservation of local laws, and a reduction in agricultural taxes.

masteryZone.q: On which saint's day was the second capture of गोवा achieved?
masteryZone.sol: Saint Catherine.

masteryZone.q: How did the death of यूसुफ आदिल शाह help the Portuguese retain गोवा?
masteryZone.sol: It caused a succession dispute in Bijapur, preventing them from launching a swift counter-offensive to retake गोवा.

masteryZone.q: What was the role of टिमोजा in the conquest of गोवा?
masteryZone.sol: He was a Hindu privateer who provided intelligence, ships, and guided the Portuguese fleet to गोवा.

masteryZone.q: What geographical feature made गोवा secure from land invasions during the monsoon?
masteryZone.sol: The Mandovi and Zuari rivers and surrounding tidal creeks created a defensive island barrier.

masteryZone.q: Where did the Portuguese fleet take shelter between May and August 1510?
masteryZone.sol: They anchored at the mouth of the Mandovi River, facing harsh monsoon conditions before returning with reinforcements.

masteryZone.q: Who was the successor of यूसुफ आदिल शाह who inherited the conflict over गोवा?
masteryZone.sol: Ismail Adil Shah.

कारण (R): The विजयनगर rulers were hostile to the Adil Shahi dynasty of Bijapur and welcomed their defeat.

masteryZone.q:
निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें: the 1510 campaign:
1. The Portuguese were driven out of गोवा in May 1510 by यूसुफ आदिल शाह.
2. अल्बुकर्क permanently recaptured गोवा on November 25, 1510.
उपरोक्त कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?
masteryZone.sol: Both statements are correct. The first campaign had two phases: retreat in May and permanent capture in November.

masteryZone.q:
निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें: the allies of अल्बुकर्क in गोवा:
1. तिम्मैया was a Hindu privateer who guided the Portuguese.
2. The विजयनगर Empire provided 10,000 soldiers to fight alongside the Portuguese in November 1510.
उपरोक्त कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?
masteryZone.sol: Statement 1 is correct. Statement 2 is incorrect because विजयनगर did not send troops; they provided diplomatic and trade support.

masteryZone.q:
With reference to the geopolitical value of गोवा, consider the following statements:
1. गोवा was a major shipyard where the Portuguese built and repaired ships.
2. गोवा was the main import center for Arabian and Persian war horses.
उपरोक्त कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?
masteryZone.sol: Both statements are correct. The harbor, shipyards, and horse trade made गोवा highly valuable.

masteryZone.q:
निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें: the aftermath of the Conquest of गोवा:
1. अल्बुकर्क massacred the local Muslim garrison and their families.
2. अल्बुकर्क abolished the traditional village tax councils (gauncars).
उपरोक्त कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?
masteryZone.sol: Statement 1 is correct. Statement 2 is incorrect because अल्बुकर्क preserved the gauncar system.

masteryZone.q:
निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें: यूसुफ आदिल शाह:
1. He was the Sultan of Bijapur during the conquest of गोवा.
2. He died in late 1510, which hampered Bijapur's efforts to retake the city.
उपरोक्त कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?
masteryZone.sol: Both statements are correct. यूसुफ आदिल शाह died in 1510, and his son Ismail Adil Shah succeeded him amid internal disputes.

masteryZone.q: Why did अल्बुकर्क select गोवा as the site for the Portuguese sovereign base in India?
masteryZone.sol: गोवा possessed a superior natural harbor shielded from monsoons, active shipyards for fleet maintenance, control over the horse trade, and a strategic position that allowed the Portuguese to influence the military balance between Bijapur and विजयनगर.

masteryZone.q: Why was the first capture of गोवा in February 1510 unsuccessful in the long run?
masteryZone.sol: अल्बुकर्क did not have sufficient troop strength to defend the city against यूसुफ आदिल शाह's counter-attack, and the onset of the monsoon trapped the Portuguese ships in the Mandovi River, forcing a retreat.

masteryZone.q: Why did अल्बुकर्क preserve the gauncar village councils in गोवा?
masteryZone.sol: Preserving the gauncar system ensured agricultural stability, minimized local administrative disruption, and secured revenue collection without requiring a large Portuguese bureaucracy.

masteryZone.q: How did the local Hindu privateer टिमोजा assist the Portuguese in their campaign?
masteryZone.sol: टिमोजा provided intelligence on Bijapur's military weaknesses, offered auxiliary ships, and helped coordinate support from the local Hindu population who were unhappy with Adil Shahi rule.

masteryZone.q: How did the timing of यूसुफ आदिल शाह's death impact the Portuguese control over गोवा?
masteryZone.sol: His death in late 1510 triggered a succession dispute in Bijapur, which distracted the sultanate and prevented them from launching a swift, organized military campaign to retake गोवा.

masteryZone.q: How did अल्बुकर्क restructure the tax administration in गोवा after the conquest?
masteryZone.sol: He preserved the traditional gauncar village councils but instituted strict audits to prevent corruption, reduced the agricultural tax rates for Hindu peasants, and redirected the taxes previously paid to Bijapur to the Portuguese Crown.

masteryZone.q: Case Study: The Battle of गोवा (November 25, 1510).
masteryZone.sol: Analyze the military strategy, troop numbers, and the subsequent consolidation of power by अल्बुकर्क during the permanent conquest of गोवा.

masteryZone.q: Case Study: Geopolitical Importance of the Indian Horse Trade.
masteryZone.sol: Examine how control over horse imports from the Persian Gulf and Arabia through गोवा was used as a foreign policy tool in South India.

masteryZone.q: Case Study: The Massacre of the Muslim Garrison in गोवा.
masteryZone.sol: Discuss the political, psychological, and strategic reasons behind अल्बुकर्क's decision to massacre the Muslim population after recapturing गोवा.

masteryZone.q: Teach the Concept: Sovereign Territory vs. Leased Factory.
masteryZone.sol: Explain the difference between operating out of a leased trading post under the jurisdiction of a local ruler and holding sovereign territorial rights over a fortified city.

masteryZone.q: Teach the Concept: Geopolitical Leverage in Trade.
masteryZone.sol: Discuss how control over a critical resource (like war horses) can be used to influence the political and military balance of power in an entire region.

masteryZone.q: Teach the Concept: The Gauncar System of गोवा.
masteryZone.sol: Explain the structure and function of the traditional village councils (gauncars) in गोवाn history and why they were preserved by colonial rulers.

sections.title: 3. रणनीतिक चोक पॉइंट्स और साम्राज्यवादी दृष्टिकोण (मलक्का और होर्मुज)
sections.content:
चोक पॉइंट्स की रणनीति: अल्बुकर्क के साम्राज्यवादी दृष्टिकोण का उद्देश्य पूरे हिंद महासागर के व्यापार नेटवर्क की नाकेबंदी करना था। वह समझते थे कि तीन प्रमुख चोक पॉइंट्स को नियंत्रित करने से पुर्तगाल को मसाले के व्यापार पर पूर्ण एकाधिकार मिल जाएगा और लाल सागर तथा फारस की खाड़ी से मुस्लिम व्यापारियों को बाहर निकाला जा सकेगा। ये चोक पॉइंट्स मलक्का जलडमरूमध्य, होर्मुज जलडमरूमध्य और बाब-अल-मंडेब (अदन) थे।

मलक्का की विजय (1511): मलक्का दक्षिण पूर्व एशिया का प्रमुख व्यापारिक केंद्र था, जो हिंद महासागर को दक्षिण चीन सागर से जोड़ता था। जुलाई-अगस्त 1511 में, अल्बुकर्क ने 1,200 पुरुषों के एक अभियान का नेतृत्व किया और एक भीषण युद्ध के बाद मलक्का सल्तनत पर कब्जा कर लिया। उन्होंने जलडमरूमध्य को सुरक्षित करने के लिए तुरंत एक विशाल पत्थर का किला, *ए फामोसा* (A Famosa) बनाया। इस कब्जे ने पुर्तगालियों को इंडोनेशिया के स्पाइस आइलैंड्स (मोलुकास) तक सीधी पहुंच प्रदान की।

होर्मुज का दमन (1515): 1515 में, अल्बुकर्क फारस की खाड़ी के मुहाने पर स्थित होर्मुज द्वीप पर गए। उन्होंने स्थानीय शासक को पुर्तगाल का जागीरदार बनने के लिए मजबूर किया और वहां एक विशाल किले का निर्माण पूरा किया। होर्मुज ने फारस की खाड़ी के व्यापार मार्गों पर पुर्तगाली नियंत्रण हासिल कर लिया, जिससे जमीनी मार्गों से वेनिस तक मसाले का प्रवाह बंद हो गया। यद्यपि 1513 में अदन पर कब्जा करने का अल्बुकर्क का प्रयास विफल रहा, लेकिन गोवा, मलक्का और होर्मुज के अधिग्रहण ने एक दुर्जेय त्रिकोणीय चोक पॉइंट प्रणाली की स्थापना की।

masteryZone.q: Which Southeast Asian trade hub was captured by अल्बुकर्क in August 1511?
masteryZone.sol: अल्बुकर्क captured the Sultanate of मलक्का in August 1511 to control the eastern passage to China.

masteryZone.q: What was the name of the massive stone fortress constructed by अल्बुकर्क in मलक्का to secure the strait?
masteryZone.sol: He constructed फोर्ट ए फामोसा (The Famous) immediately after capturing मलक्का.

masteryZone.q: In which strategic strait at the entrance of the Persian Gulf did अल्बुकर्क build a fort in 1515?
masteryZone.sol: अल्बुकर्क captured होर्मुज at the entrance of the Persian Gulf in 1515, completing his western chokepoint strategy.

masteryZone.q: Which major Red Sea chokepoint did अल्बुकर्क fail to capture during his 1513 campaign?
masteryZone.sol: अल्बुकर्क launched an assault on अदन in 1513 but was repulsed by the local defenders.

masteryZone.q: What was the primary geopolitical goal of अल्बुकर्क's chokepoint strategy?
masteryZone.sol: His strategy aimed to control maritime bottlenecks to intercept spice trade routes and exclude rival traders.
opts: To blockade the spice trade and exclude Muslim traders from the Indian Ocean
To conquer the Ming Dynasty of China
To establish overland routes to Europe through Russia
To build a canal connecting the Red Sea to the Mediterranean

masteryZone.q: Which of the following strategic chokepoints were successfully secured by अल्बुकर्क? (Select all that apply)
masteryZone.sol: अल्बुकर्क captured गोवा, मलक्का, and होर्मुज, but failed to capture अदन.

masteryZone.q: What were the consequences of the capture of मलक्का in 1511? (Select all that apply)
masteryZone.sol: It gave direct access to the Moluccas, controlled the China route, and led to फोर्ट ए फामोसा. China was not collapsed.
opts: Direct Portuguese access to the Spice Islands (Moluccas)
Control over the trade route between India and the South China Sea
The construction of फोर्ट ए फामोसा
The immediate collapse of the Ming Dynasty in China

masteryZone.q: Identify the features of अल्बुकर्क's campaign in होर्मुज (1515). (Select all that apply)
masteryZone.sol: होर्मुज was successfully vassalized, a fort was built, and Persian Gulf routes were blocked. The campaign was a victory, not a defeat.
opts: Forced the local ruler to become a vassal of Portugal
Completed the construction of a major Portuguese fortress
Blocked the Persian Gulf trade routes to Venice
Suffered a major military defeat and loss of all ships

masteryZone.q: Which factors contributed to the Portuguese failure to capture अदन in 1513? (Select all that apply)
masteryZone.sol: अदन had strong defenses, the Portuguese lacked ladders, and the climate was hostile. The British navy did not exist in India then.
opts: Lack of sufficient scaling ladders during the assault
Hostile climate and lack of water for the besiegers
The intervention of the British navy

masteryZone.q: What resources or goods were heavily traded through मलक्का? (Select all that apply)
masteryZone.sol: Spices, Chinese silk, and sandalwood were key trades in मलक्का. Potatoes were introduced later from the Americas.
opts: Nutmeg and cloves from the Moluccas

masteryZone.q: सत्य या असत्य: The capture of मलक्का allowed the Portuguese to directly bypass Muslim middlemen in the spice trade.
masteryZone.sol: By controlling मलक्का, they could sail directly to the Spice Islands and buy spices at the source.

masteryZone.q: सत्य या असत्य: फोर्ट ए फामोसा in मलक्का was constructed entirely of wood and destroyed by fire in 1512.
masteryZone.sol: It was a massive stone fortress that survived for centuries and became a symbol of Portuguese power.

masteryZone.q: सत्य या असत्य: होर्मुज was captured by अल्बुकर्क during his first expedition in 1507, but he had to abandon it before returning to consolidate power in 1515.
masteryZone.sol: अल्बुकर्क attacked होर्मुज in 1507 and started a fort, but mutinous captains forced him to abandon it until he returned as Governor in 1515.

masteryZone.q: सत्य या असत्य: अल्बुकर्क succeeded in blockading the Red Sea route completely by capturing अदन.
masteryZone.sol: His failure to capture अदन meant the Red Sea route remained partially open to Muslim traders.

masteryZone.q: सत्य या असत्य: The ruler of होर्मुज was forced to pay tribute and fly the Portuguese flag over his palace.
masteryZone.sol: होर्मुज became a vassal state paying annual tribute to the Portuguese Crown.

masteryZone.q: सत्य या असत्य: The Strait of मलक्का connects the Indian Ocean with the Persian Gulf.
masteryZone.sol: The Strait of मलक्का connects the Indian Ocean with the South China Sea/Pacific Ocean.

masteryZone.q: सत्य या असत्य: अल्बुकर्क died in मलक्का shortly after constructing the fortress.
masteryZone.sol: He died off the coast of गोवा in December 1515, after returning from होर्मुज.

masteryZone.q: सत्य या असत्य: The conquest of मलक्का was led by Francisco de अल्मेडा.
masteryZone.sol: The conquest of मलक्का was planned and led by Afonso de अल्बुकर्क in 1511.

masteryZone.q: The Portuguese constructed the fortress of A __________ in मलक्का to secure the strait.
masteryZone.sol: फोर्ट ए फामोसा was built in मलक्का in 1511.

masteryZone.q: अल्बुकर्क captured the Strait of मलक्का in the year __________ CE.
masteryZone.sol: मलक्का was captured in August 1511.

masteryZone.q: The strategic island fortress at the entrance of the Persian Gulf secured by अल्बुकर्क was __________.
masteryZone.sol: होर्मुज (होर्मुज) was secured in 1515.

masteryZone.q: अल्बुकर्क failed to capture the Red Sea port of __________ in 1513.
masteryZone.sol: अदन was the failed siege of 1513.

masteryZone.q: The Strait of मलक्का connects the Indian Ocean with the __________ China Sea.
masteryZone.sol: It connects with the South China Sea.

masteryZone.q: The ruler of होर्मुज became a __________ of the Portuguese Crown.
masteryZone.sol: He became a vassal paying tribute and accepting Portuguese control.

masteryZone.q: The fortress built by अल्बुकर्क in होर्मुज was named the Redoubt of Our Lady of the __________.
masteryZone.sol: It was named the Redoubt of Our Lady of the Conception.

masteryZone.q: The primary trade goods that the Portuguese sought to control in मलक्का were __________.
masteryZone.sol: Moluccan spices (nutmeg, cloves) were the main targets.

masteryZone.q: मिलान करें chokepoints with their geographical coordinates/bodies of water:
masteryZone.sol: मलक्का is the eastern strait, होर्मुज is the Persian Gulf entry, and Bab-el-Mandeb is the Red Sea entry.

options.text: Connects Indian Ocean to South China Sea
Connects Arabian Sea to Persian Gulf
Connects Arabian Sea to Red Sea (अदन)

masteryZone.q: मिलान करें strategic actions with their dates:
masteryZone.sol: मलक्का in 1511, अदन in 1513, होर्मुज in 1515.

masteryZone.q: मिलान करें fortresses with the cities they protected:
masteryZone.sol: A Famosa in मलक्का, Our Lady of the Conception in होर्मुज, and फोर्ट मैनुअल in कोचीन.

masteryZone.q: What was the strategic importance of the Strait of मलक्का?
masteryZone.sol: It was the primary naval passage connecting the Indian Ocean to the Pacific, controlling trade between India, China, and the Moluccas.

masteryZone.q: Why did अल्बुकर्क construct फोर्ट ए फामोसा in मलक्का?
masteryZone.sol: To secure the Portuguese garrison and hold the Strait of मलक्का against counter-attacks by the deposed Sultan.

masteryZone.q: Which country's trade was severely disrupted by the Portuguese capture of होर्मुज?
masteryZone.sol: Venice, as it cut off the overland spice route via the Persian Gulf and Levant.

masteryZone.q: How did the failure to capture अदन affect अल्बुकर्क's blockade strategy?
masteryZone.sol: It left the Red Sea route open, allowing some spice trade to continue flowing to Egypt and Venice.

masteryZone.q: Who was the Sultan of मलक्का when अल्बुकर्क captured the city in 1511?
masteryZone.sol: Sultan Mahmud Shah.

masteryZone.q: What did अल्बुकर्क use as building materials for फोर्ट ए फामोसा?
masteryZone.sol: Stone from local mosques and graves of the former rulers to speed up construction and assert dominance.

masteryZone.q: How many men did अल्बुकर्क command during the conquest of मलक्का?
masteryZone.sol: Around 1,200 men, including Portuguese soldiers and native Auxiliaries.

masteryZone.q: What terms did the King of होर्मुज accept in 1515?
masteryZone.sol: He accepted Portuguese vassalage, paid an annual tribute, and allowed the construction of a Portuguese fortress.

masteryZone.q:
निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें: the capture of मलक्का:
1. It occurred in August 1511.
2. अल्बुकर्क constructed the fortress of फोर्ट ए फामोसा using stone from local mosques.
उपरोक्त कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?
masteryZone.sol: Both statements are correct. The fortress was built immediately after the conquest in August 1511.

masteryZone.q:
निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें: the होर्मुज campaign:
1. अल्बुकर्क first attempted to fortify होर्मुज in 1507.
2. He permanently secured होर्मुज in 1515 as Governor.
उपरोक्त कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?
masteryZone.sol: Both statements are correct. His 1507 campaign was interrupted by a mutiny, but he completed the task in 1515.

masteryZone.q:
With reference to the Red Sea campaign of 1513, consider the following statements:
1. अल्बुकर्क successfully captured अदन.
2. The Portuguese fleet entered the Red Sea and anchored at Socotra.
उपरोक्त कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?
masteryZone.sol: Statement 1 is incorrect because he failed to capture अदन. Statement 2 is correct; Socotra was used as a base.

masteryZone.q:
निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें: the geopolitical impacts of अल्बुकर्क's conquests:
1. The spice flow to Venice via Alexandria was completely cut off by the capture of अदन.
2. मलक्का gave the Portuguese access to Chinese and Japanese markets.
उपरोक्त कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?
masteryZone.sol: Statement 1 is incorrect because अदन was not captured, leaving the Red Sea route partially open. Statement 2 is correct.

masteryZone.q:
निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें: the fortress of होर्मुज:
1. It was named the Redoubt of Our Lady of the Conception.
2. It allowed the Portuguese to collect customs duties on all ships entering the Persian Gulf.
उपरोक्त कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?
masteryZone.sol: Both statements are correct. The fort controlled the mouth of the Persian Gulf and generated large customs revenues.

masteryZone.q: Why was the Strait of मलक्का critical to the Portuguese global empire?
masteryZone.sol: It was the gateway to East Asia, connecting the Indian Ocean to the South China Sea. Controlling it allowed the Portuguese to secure the spice trade at the source and trade directly with China.

masteryZone.q: Why did अल्बुकर्क's assault on अदन in 1513 fail?
masteryZone.sol: अदन had high walls and determined defenders, and the Portuguese lacked proper equipment, specifically scaling ladders of sufficient height. Hostile climate and water shortages also forced them to lift the siege.

masteryZone.q: Why did the capture of होर्मुज impact the trade routes of Venice?
masteryZone.sol: होर्मुज controlled the Persian Gulf route. By taxing and blockading this route, the Portuguese cut off the supply of spices to Venice via overland trade routes, giving Lisbon a monopoly.

masteryZone.q: How did अल्बुकर्क implement his 'Chokepoints Strategy'?
masteryZone.sol: He identified the key geographical entry and exit points of the Indian Ocean (गोवा, मलक्का, होर्मुज, अदन) and sought to build fortresses at each to control and tax all maritime traffic.

masteryZone.q: How did अल्बुकर्क use materials from local structures in मलक्का to build फोर्ट ए फामोसा?
masteryZone.sol: He dismantled mosques and tombs of the former sultans to provide immediate stone for the fort, which also served to break the morale of the local Muslim population.

masteryZone.q: How did the vassalage of होर्मुज benefit the Portuguese treasury?
masteryZone.sol: The King of होर्मुज paid a large annual tribute in gold, and the Portuguese customs house at होर्मुज taxed all merchant shipping entering or leaving the Persian Gulf.

masteryZone.q: Case Study: The Conquest of मलक्का (1511).
masteryZone.sol: Analyze the tactical challenges of assaulting a major city across a divided river and the subsequent construction of फोर्ट ए फामोसा.

masteryZone.q: Case Study: The failed Siege of अदन (1513).
masteryZone.sol: Evaluate the military, planning, and environmental factors that led to the repulse of the Portuguese forces at अदन.

masteryZone.q: Case Study: The Geopolitics of the Persian Gulf (1507-1515).
masteryZone.sol: Examine how अल्बुकर्क leveraged naval power to establish a protectorate over the wealthy trading island of होर्मुज.

masteryZone.q: Teach the Concept: Maritime Chokepoints in Imperial Strategy.
masteryZone.sol: Explain how controlling narrow channels of water can grant a nation control over global shipping, trade routes, and military movements.

masteryZone.q: Teach the Concept: Fortress Warfare in Asia.
masteryZone.sol: Describe how European stone fortifications (like फोर्ट ए फामोसा) allowed small garrisons to hold territory against much larger local armies.

masteryZone.q: Teach the Concept: Vassalage and Protectorates in Early Empires.
masteryZone.sol: Explain the administrative model where a local ruler remains on the throne but operates under the military and economic control of an imperial power.

sections.title: 4. सामाजिक-धार्मिक सुधार और अंतर-विवाह की नीति
sections.content:
अंतर-विवाह की नीति (कासाडोस): पुर्तगाल को जनसांख्यिकीय संकट का सामना करना पड़ रहा था, क्योंकि उसकी कुल घरेलू जनसंख्या केवल 10 लाख थी। अकेले पुर्तगाली सैनिकों के साथ एक वैश्विक साम्राज्य की रक्षा करना असंभव था। इसे हल करने के लिए, अल्बुकर्क ने मिश्रित विवाहों (*casados*) की नीति शुरू की। उन्होंने पुर्तगाली सैनिकों को गोवा में बसने, युद्धों में मारे गए मुस्लिम सैनिकों की विधवाओं से विवाह करने और उन्हें ईसाई धर्म में परिवर्तित करने के लिए प्रोत्साहित किया। क्राउन ने इन जोड़ों को भूमि, घर और कर छूट प्रदान की। इस नीति ने सफलतापूर्वक एक वफादार, स्थायी, भारत-पुर्तगाली आबादी की स्थापना की, जिसने स्थानीय प्रशासन, कृषि और रक्षा की रीढ़ के रूप में कार्य किया।

सामाजिक और प्रशासनिक सुधार: अल्बुकर्क एक सक्रिय प्रशासक थे। गोवा पर कब्जा करने के बाद, उन्होंने तुरंत सती प्रथा (विधवा दाह) को समाप्त कर दिया। भारत में किसी यूरोपीय शक्ति द्वारा सती प्रथा को प्रतिबंधित करने का यह पहला दर्ज उदाहरण था, जो ब्रिटिश कानून से 300 वर्ष से अधिक पुराना था। उन्होंने कृषि राजस्व एकत्र करने के लिए पारंपरिक ग्राम परिषदों (*gauncars*) को बनाए रखा लेकिन भ्रष्टाचार को रोकने के लिए कर प्रशासन में सुधार किया। उन्होंने पुर्तगाली सहायक बलों में सेवा करने के लिए स्थानीय भारतीय सैनिकों (जिन्हें *लश्कर* कहा जाता था) की भी भर्ती की, जो स्थानीय शासन के प्रति उनके व्यावहारिक दृष्टिकोण को दर्शाता है।

masteryZone.q: What was the Portuguese term for the married settlers who participated in अल्बुकर्क's intermarriage policy?
masteryZone.sol: कासाडोस was the term used for Portuguese men who married local women and settled in गोवा.

masteryZone.q: Which major social practice in India was abolished by अल्बुकर्क in गोवा in 1510?
masteryZone.sol: अल्बुकर्क banned सती in गोवा immediately after the conquest, the first European ban on the practice in India.

masteryZone.q: What did the Portuguese Crown provide to the कासाडोस to encourage permanent settlement in गोवा?
masteryZone.sol: To encourage settlement, the Crown granted कासाडोस land, houses, and exemptions from local taxes.

masteryZone.q: Who did अल्बुकर्क encourage his soldiers to marry under the intermarriage policy?
masteryZone.sol: He targeted the widows of Muslim soldiers killed during the capture of गोवा, converting them to Christianity first.
opts: Widows of Muslim defenders killed in the conquests
Daughters of the विजयनगर royal family

masteryZone.q: What was the name of the native auxiliary troops recruited by अल्बुकर्क to serve under Portuguese officers?
masteryZone.sol: लश्कर (Lascars) was the term for native Indian sailors and soldiers recruited into Portuguese service.

masteryZone.q: Which of the following were features of अल्बुकर्क's intermarriage policy? (Select all that apply)
masteryZone.sol: The policy encouraged marriages with converted local women, offering land and tax benefits. Celibacy was not enforced; marriage was promoted.
opts: Encouraging marriages between Portuguese soldiers and local women
Requiring local brides to convert to Christianity
Granting land and tax exemptions to married couples
Enforcing strict celibacy among all soldiers

masteryZone.q: What were the objectives of banning सती in गोवा? (Select all that apply)
masteryZone.sol: The ban was motivated by Christian morals, the need for brides, and weakening local elites. It did not aim to expel Hindus.
opts: Humanitarian reform based on Christian morals
To save widows who could marry Portuguese settlers
To undermine the social authority of local religious elites
To force all Hindus to flee गोवा

masteryZone.q: Identify the groups that made up the social hierarchy of Portuguese गोवा under अल्बुकर्क. (Select all that apply)
masteryZone.sol: कासाडोस, लश्कर (Lascars), and Reinois were key groups. Mughals had no presence in गोवा at this time.

masteryZone.q: What administrative roles did the कासाडोस play in गोवा? (Select all that apply)
masteryZone.sol: कासाडोस worked in trade, farming, defense, and local council administration. They did not serve as viceroys in Lisbon.
opts: Serving as supreme viceroys in Lisbon

masteryZone.q: Which local customs or systems did अल्बुकर्क choose to preserve or reform rather than abolish? (Select all that apply)
masteryZone.sol: He kept the gauncar system, local currencies, and Hindu civil courts, but abolished सती.
opts: The gauncar village tax collection system
The use of local currencies with minor modifications
The local judicial councils for civil disputes among Hindus

masteryZone.q: सत्य या असत्य: The intermarriage policy was introduced because Portugal had a small population and could not send enough settlers to India.
masteryZone.sol: With a population of only one million, Portugal relied on mixed marriages to create a loyal local population.

masteryZone.q: सत्य या असत्य: सती was banned in गोवा by the British in 1510.
masteryZone.sol: It was banned by the Portuguese under अल्बुकर्क in 1510. The British banned it in 1829 under William Bentinck.

masteryZone.q: सत्य या असत्य: Indian women who married Portuguese settlers under the policy were allowed to retain their Islamic or Hindu faiths.
masteryZone.sol: Conversion to Christianity was a mandatory requirement for these marriages.

masteryZone.q: सत्य या असत्य: लश्कर (Lascars) were native soldiers who fought only in naval battles and never on land.
masteryZone.sol: लश्कर (Lascars) served in both naval and land campaigns as auxiliary forces.

masteryZone.q: सत्य या असत्य: अल्बुकर्क's ban on सती was met with violent rebellion from the local Hindu population.
masteryZone.sol: The Hindu population generally accepted the ban, and many praised अल्बुकर्क for protecting women.

masteryZone.q: सत्य या असत्य: The term Casado literally means 'married man' in Portuguese.
masteryZone.sol: It comes from the Portuguese word for 'house' (casa) or 'married' (casar).

masteryZone.q: सत्य या असत्य: अल्बुकर्क forced all Portuguese soldiers to marry local women under penalty of death.
masteryZone.sol: The policy was voluntary and encouraged using incentives like land and cash grants.

masteryZone.q: सत्य या असत्य: The traditional village council system in गोवा was called the gauncar system.
masteryZone.sol: The gauncars were preserved to collect agricultural revenues.

masteryZone.q: Portuguese men who married local women and settled in गोवा were called __________.
masteryZone.sol: कासाडोस were the key class of settlers.

masteryZone.q: अल्बुकर्क banned the practice of __________ in गोवा in 1510.
masteryZone.sol: सती (widow burning) was prohibited.

masteryZone.q: The native auxiliary forces recruited by the Portuguese were known as __________.
masteryZone.sol: लश्कर (Lascars) served as auxiliary troops.

masteryZone.q: The intermarriage policy was designed to solve Portugal's __________ deficit in India.
masteryZone.sol: A small home population meant they had a demographic deficit.

masteryZone.q: Local brides of Portuguese soldiers had to convert to __________ before marriage.
masteryZone.sol: Christian conversion was mandatory.

masteryZone.q: The Crown gave कासाडोस land, houses, and __________ exemptions.
masteryZone.sol: Tax exemptions were a key financial incentive.

masteryZone.q: अल्बुकर्क's ban on सती pre-dated the British ban by more than __________ centuries.
masteryZone.sol: Banned in 1510 vs. British ban in 1829 (over 300 years later).

masteryZone.q: The village councils that managed land revenue in गोवा were called __________.
masteryZone.sol: The gauncars were preserved under the Portuguese administration.

masteryZone.q: मिलान करें social groups in Portuguese गोवा with their descriptions:
masteryZone.sol: कासाडोस were settled/married, Reinois were soldiers from the home country, and लश्कर (Lascars) were native auxiliaries.

options.text: Settled, married Portuguese men with land grants
Soldiers arriving directly from Portugal for service
Native Indian sailors and auxiliary troops

masteryZone.q: मिलान करें policies with their social objectives:
masteryZone.sol: सती ban protected widows, intermarriage built a loyal population, and gauncars stabilized revenue.

options.text: Protect widows and assert Christian moral authority
Build a loyal domestic Indo-Portuguese population
Ensure stable revenue collection and farming

masteryZone.q: मिलान करें historic reforms with their respective dates or regions:
masteryZone.sol: सती banned in गोवा in 1510, in British India in 1829, and गोवा was captured in Nov 1510.

masteryZone.q: What was the primary demographic challenge faced by the Portuguese in India?
masteryZone.sol: Portugal's small population (approx. 1 million) made it impossible to garrison a global empire with Portuguese-born soldiers alone.

masteryZone.q: Why did अल्बुकर्क target the widows of fallen Muslim soldiers for his marriage policy?
masteryZone.sol: Because they were already in the captured city, lacked local male protection, and marrying them consolidated control over properties.

masteryZone.q: How did the local Hindu population react to the ban on सती in 1510?
masteryZone.sol: They generally welcomed the ban as a humane measure, which improved relations between Hindus and the Portuguese.

masteryZone.q: What financial privileges were granted to the कासाडोस?
masteryZone.sol: They were given land grants, housing assistance, and exemptions from municipal taxes.

masteryZone.q: What role did the लश्कर (Lascars) play in the Portuguese expansion?
masteryZone.sol: They served as auxiliary soldiers, sailors, and laborers, providing critical manpower for military campaigns.

masteryZone.q: Who was the first European ruler to ban सती in India?
masteryZone.sol: Afonso de अल्बुकर्क.

masteryZone.q: How did the intermarriage policy help secure the territory of गोवा?
masteryZone.sol: It created a stable, loyal class of Indo-Portuguese families who defended the colony as a local militia during emergencies.

masteryZone.q: Did the Portuguese preserve the traditional laws of गोवाn village communities?
masteryZone.sol: Yes, they preserved the gauncar system to manage agricultural taxes and resolve local civil disputes.

कारण (R): The Portuguese military faced manpower shortages and needed local recruits to garrison remote forts.

कारण (R): अल्बुकर्क wanted to prevent the rise of a local landowning class that could challenge his authority.
