masteryZone.q:
निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें: the intermarriage policy:
1. It was mandatory for all Portuguese soldiers to marry local women.
2. The policy targeted widows of fallen Muslim soldiers.
उपरोक्त कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?
masteryZone.sol: Statement 1 is incorrect because it was voluntary. Statement 2 is correct.

masteryZone.q:
निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें: the abolition of सती:
1. सती was abolished in गोवा in 1510.
2. The ban was implemented by Governor Afonso de अल्बुकर्क.
उपरोक्त कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?
masteryZone.sol: Both statements are correct. अल्बुकर्क banned सती in गोवा in 1510.

masteryZone.q:
With reference to the gauncars in गोवा, consider the following statements:
1. They were traditional village councils that managed land revenue.
2. They were completely abolished by the Portuguese to establish direct rule.
उपरोक्त कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?
masteryZone.sol: Statement 1 is correct. Statement 2 is incorrect because the gauncars were preserved, not abolished.

masteryZone.q:
निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें: the लश्कर (Lascars):
1. They were native auxiliary soldiers and sailors.
2. They served under Portuguese military officers in campaigns across the Indian Ocean.
उपरोक्त कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?
masteryZone.sol: Both statements are correct. लश्कर (Lascars) were crucial native forces in the Portuguese military system.

masteryZone.q:
निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें: the social hierarchy in गोवा:
1. कासाडोस held a higher social status than Reinois.
2. Reinois were soldiers who arrived directly from Portugal and did not settle.
उपरोक्त कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?
masteryZone.sol: Statement 1 is incorrect because Reinois (home-born Portuguese) often held higher military and social ranks than कासाडोस. Statement 2 is correct.

masteryZone.q: Why did अल्बुकर्क encourage intermarriage between Portuguese soldiers and local women?
masteryZone.sol: To address the critical shortage of Portuguese settlers and soldiers, creating a permanent, loyal Indo-Portuguese population to garrison, farm, and administer the colony.

masteryZone.q: Why did the Portuguese Crown support the intermarriage policy with financial incentives?
masteryZone.sol: It was cheaper and safer to settle soldiers locally than to constantly recruit, train, and transport new soldiers from Europe to India, who often died during the journey.

masteryZone.q: Why was सती banned by अल्बुकर्क in गोवा?
masteryZone.sol: It was driven by Christian moral objections to the practice of widow burning, as well as the strategic need to protect widows who could then marry Portuguese soldiers under his settlement policy.

masteryZone.q: How did the कासाडोस contribute to the economic development of गोवा?
masteryZone.sol: They settled as farmers, artisans, and merchants, establishing local agriculture and trade networks that stabilized the colonial economy and generated taxes for the Crown.

masteryZone.q: How did the preservation of the gauncar system benefit the Portuguese administration?
masteryZone.sol: It minimized local resistance by leaving traditional village self-governance intact, while ensuring a steady, organized collection of agricultural revenues without administrative overhead.

masteryZone.q: How did the recruitment of लश्कर (Lascars) alter the military capabilities of the Portuguese?
masteryZone.sol: It provided the Portuguese with large numbers of auxiliary troops who were acclimated to the local environment and climate, reducing the reliance on scarce European soldiers.

masteryZone.q: Case Study: The कासाडोस of गोवा.
masteryZone.sol: Examine the social origins, economic privileges, and political influence of the married Portuguese settlers in गोवाn history.

masteryZone.q: Case Study: The Abolition of सती in 1510.
masteryZone.sol: Analyze the local reactions, religious arguments, and historical significance of the Portuguese ban on widow burning in गोवा.

masteryZone.q: Case Study: Native Auxiliaries (लश्कर (Lascars)) in colonial armies.
masteryZone.sol: Investigate how the Portuguese integrated local Indian manpower into their military structures to maintain a global empire with limited European troops.

masteryZone.q: Teach the Concept: Demographic Constraints in Early Colonialism.
masteryZone.sol: Explain how a small mother country's limited population size shaped the policies and structures of its overseas colonies.

masteryZone.q: Teach the Concept: Preservation of Local Administrative Structures.
masteryZone.sol: Discuss why early colonial powers often choose to keep traditional administrative and tax systems intact rather than replace them entirely.

masteryZone.q: Teach the Concept: Syncretism and Creole Cultures.
masteryZone.sol: Explain how intermarriage and cultural exchange lead to the formation of unique, syncretic societies in colonial settings.

sections.title: 5. गठबंधन, व्यापार एकाधिकार और मृत्यु (1515)
sections.content:
विजयनगर के साथ राजनयिक गठबंधन: बीजापुर सल्तनत जैसी शत्रुतापूर्ण शक्तियों का मुकाबला करने के लिए, अल्बुकर्क ने विजयनगर साम्राज्य के सम्राट कृष्ण देव राय के साथ एक करीबी गठबंधन विकसित किया। उन्होंने गोवा के माध्यम से फारसी और अरब युद्ध के घोड़ों के आयात पर विजयनगर को पूर्ण एकाधिकार प्रदान करके इस संबंध को मजबूत किया, जिससे दक्कन सल्तनतों को इन सैन्य संपत्तियों से वंचित कर दिया गया। बदले में, कृष्ण देव राय ने पुर्तगालियों को भटकल में एक कारखाना बनाने की अनुमति दी और बीजापुर के खिलाफ उनकी उपस्थिति का समर्थन किया।

गवर्नर का पतन और मृत्यु: अल्बुकर्क के आक्रामक, स्वायत्त कार्यों और लिस्बन दरबार में उनके कई प्रतिद्वंद्वियों ने उनके राजनीतिक पतन का मार्ग प्रशस्त किया। उनके दुश्मनों ने राजा मैनुअल प्रथम को आश्वस्त किया कि अल्बुकर्क भारत में एक स्वतंत्र साम्राज्य बनाने की योजना रहे हैं। 1515 के अंत में, राजा ने उनके कट्टर प्रतिद्वंद्वी लोपो सोरेस डी अल्बेरिया को उनकी जगह लेने के लिए नियुक्त किया। होर्मुज से गोवा लौटते समय अल्बुकर्क को अपनी बर्खास्तगी की खबर मिली। पहले से ही गंभीर रूप से बीमार, 16 दिसंबर, 1515 को गोवा के बंदरगाह के पास समुद्र में उनकी मृत्यु हो गई। उन्हें गोवा के चर्च ऑफ नोसा सेन्होरा दा सेरा में दफनाया गया, जहाँ पुर्तगाली निवासियों और स्थानीय हिंदू आबादी दोनों ने उनकी मृत्यु पर गहरा शोक व्यक्त किया।

masteryZone.q: Which विजयनगर Emperor formed a close diplomatic alliance with अल्बुकर्क?
masteryZone.sol: कृष्ण देव राय was the विजयनगर ruler who allied with अल्बुकर्क to secure a horse trade monopoly.

masteryZone.q: What military import did अल्बुकर्क grant विजयनगर a complete monopoly over?
masteryZone.sol: अल्बुकर्क granted विजयनगर a monopoly on the import of war horses through गोवा, denying them to the Deccan Sultanates.

masteryZone.q: Who was appointed by राजा मैनुअल प्रथम in 1515 to replace अल्बुकर्क as Governor of India?
masteryZone.sol: लोपो सोरेस डी अल्बेरिया, अल्बुकर्क's bitter rival, was appointed to replace him.

masteryZone.q: Where did अल्बुकर्क die in December 1515?
masteryZone.sol: He died on board a ship off the coast of गोवा on December 16, 1515, returning from होर्मुज.
opts: At sea near the harbor of गोवा

masteryZone.q: In which church in गोवा was अल्बुकर्क originally buried?
masteryZone.sol: He was buried in the Church of Nossa Senhora da Serra in गोवा, according to his wishes.

masteryZone.q: Which of the following were terms or outcomes of the alliance between Portugal and विजयनगर? (Select all that apply)
masteryZone.sol: The treaty provided a horse monopoly, a factory at Bhatkal, and mutual support against Bijapur. गोवा was captured from Bijapur, not विजयनगर.
opts: विजयनगर secured a monopoly on war horse imports
The Portuguese were allowed to build a factory at Bhatkal
विजयनगर supported the Portuguese against Bijapur
विजयनगर ceded गोवा to the Portuguese in 1503

masteryZone.q: What factors led to the dismissal of अल्बुकर्क by राजा मैनुअल प्रथम? (Select all that apply)
masteryZone.sol: His rivals accused him of wanting to carve out a kingdom, and the King became suspicious. होर्मुज was successfully captured, and spice trade continued.
opts: Accusations by court rivals that अल्बुकर्क wanted an independent kingdom
The King's suspicion of अल्बुकर्क's growing power
अल्बुकर्क's decision to stop spice trade with Lisbon

masteryZone.q: Identify the actions taken by अल्बुकर्क to secure the trade monopoly in the Indian Ocean. (Select all that apply)
masteryZone.sol: He used the कार्तज (Cartaz), excluded Muslim shipping, and built chokepoint forts. He taxed trade in गोवा, not abolished it.
opts: Excluding Muslim merchants from direct spice shipping
Abolishing all customs taxes in गोवा

masteryZone.q: Who were the primary regional rivals of the Portuguese-विजयनगर alliance? (Select all that apply)
masteryZone.sol: Bijapur and other Bahmani successor states were their main rivals. The British and French companies were formed much later.
opts: The Adil Shahi Dynasty of Bijapur

masteryZone.q: Which of the following details are true about अल्बुकर्क's death and legacy? (Select all that apply)
masteryZone.sol: He died off गोवा, was mourned by both communities, and buried in गोवा. His remains were found and buried.
opts: He died at sea off गोवा in December 1515
He was deeply mourned by both Portuguese and local Hindus
He was buried in the Church of Nossa Senhora da Serra

masteryZone.q: सत्य या असत्य: कृष्ण देव राय was the Emperor of विजयनगर who allied with अल्बुकर्क.
masteryZone.sol: कृष्ण देव राय ruled विजयनगर (1509-1529) and allied with अल्बुकर्क.

masteryZone.q: सत्य या असत्य: The Portuguese built their first factory in the विजयनगर territory at Bhatkal.
masteryZone.sol: Under the treaty, they were permitted to build a factory at Bhatkal.

masteryZone.q: सत्य या असत्य: अल्बुकर्क died in Lisbon after being arrested and brought back to Portugal.
masteryZone.sol: He died at sea off गोवा, having never reached Lisbon after his dismissal.

masteryZone.q: सत्य या असत्य: लोपो सोरेस डी अल्बेरिया was अल्बुकर्क's close friend and designated successor.
masteryZone.sol: लोपो सोरेस डी अल्बेरिया was अल्बुकर्क's bitter rival who was appointed to replace him.

masteryZone.q: सत्य या असत्य: अल्बुकर्क's enemies at the Lisbon court accused him of plotting to make himself an independent King of India.
masteryZone.sol: They leveraged his aggressive, autonomous actions to make राजा मैनुअल प्रथम suspicious.

masteryZone.q: सत्य या असत्य: The horse trade monopoly was a minor trade route with little political impact.
masteryZone.sol: The war horse monopoly was vital because cavalry was the key military asset for the Deccan kingdoms.

masteryZone.q: सत्य या असत्य: अल्बुकर्क was buried in गोवा, and his tomb became a site of respect for local Hindus.
masteryZone.sol: Local Hindus respected him for his administrative justice and visited his grave to seek justice.

masteryZone.q: सत्य या असत्य: राजा मैनुअल प्रथम regretted dismissing अल्बुकर्क after learning of his death.
masteryZone.sol: The King realized the loss of his greatest commander and tried to restore him to favor, but it was too late.

masteryZone.q: The Emperor of विजयनगर who allied with अल्बुकर्क was __________ Deva Raya.
masteryZone.sol: कृष्ण देव राय was the विजयनगर ruler.

masteryZone.q: अल्बुकर्क granted विजयनगर a monopoly over the import of __________.
masteryZone.sol: The war horse trade import was monopolized.

masteryZone.q: अल्बुकर्क's successor as Governor of India was Lopo Soares de __________.
masteryZone.sol: लोपो सोरेस डी अल्बेरिया was his successor.

masteryZone.q: अल्बुकर्क died at sea off the coast of __________ in December 1515.
masteryZone.sol: He died near the harbor of गोवा.

masteryZone.q: The Portuguese built a factory at __________ under the treaty with विजयनगर.
masteryZone.sol: Bhatkal was the site of the Portuguese factory.

masteryZone.q: The Portuguese King who dismissed अल्बुकर्क was __________ I.
masteryZone.sol: राजा मैनुअल प्रथम dismissed him under influence from court rivals.

masteryZone.q: अल्बुकर्क was buried in गोवा inside the Church of Nossa Senhora da __________.
masteryZone.sol: Nossa Senhora da Serra was the name of the church.

masteryZone.q: The trade pass system used by the Portuguese to enforce their maritime monopoly was called the __________ system.
masteryZone.sol: The कार्तज (Cartaz) system required all merchant ships to pay duties and buy licenses.

masteryZone.q: मिलान करें historical figures with their actions in 1515:
masteryZone.sol: अल्बुकर्क died, राजा मैनुअल प्रथम issued the decree, and Lopo Soares arrived to succeed him.

options.text: Died at sea off गोवा after being dismissed
Issued the decree replacing his governor
Arrived in India to take office as successor

masteryZone.q: मिलान करें treaties and factories with their locations:
masteryZone.sol: विजयनगर treaty allowed Bhatkal factory, गोवा was taken in 1510, and होर्मुज fort was built at Persian Gulf.

options.text: Fortified at the entrance of the Persian Gulf

masteryZone.q: मिलान करें administrative terms with their meanings:
masteryZone.sol: कार्तज (Cartaz) was the trade license, Feitoria was the factory, and Nossa Senhora da Serra was the burial church.

masteryZone.q: What diplomatic goal did अल्बुकर्क achieve by allying with विजयनगर?
masteryZone.sol: He secured a major military ally against the hostile Bijapur Sultanate and established Portuguese trade factories in South India.

masteryZone.q: How did अल्बुकर्क use the horse trade as a diplomatic weapon?
masteryZone.sol: He gave विजयनगर exclusive import rights, denying war horses to the Deccan Sultanates and keeping them dependent on Portuguese goodwill.

masteryZone.q: What rumor did अल्बुकर्क's enemies spread at the court in Lisbon?
masteryZone.sol: They rumored that he was plotting to set up an independent kingdom in India and break away from the Portuguese Crown.

masteryZone.q: What were the last words or sentiments of अल्बुकर्क upon learning of his dismissal?
masteryZone.sol: He expressed bitterness that he had fallen out of favor with the King due to court intrigues, saying 'To the grave with me, for I am in bad favor with the King, and the King is in bad favor with me.'

masteryZone.q: Why was अल्बुकर्क buried in गोवा instead of being sent to Lisbon immediately?
masteryZone.sol: It was his personal wish to be buried in the land he conquered, though his remains were later moved to Lisbon in 1566.

masteryZone.q: Which South Indian port was granted to the Portuguese for a factory under the विजयनगर treaty?
masteryZone.sol: Bhatkal.

masteryZone.q: What system did the Portuguese use to control and tax non-Portuguese shipping in the Indian Ocean?
masteryZone.sol: The कार्तज (Cartaz) system.

masteryZone.q: Who was the chief court rival of अल्बुकर्क who replaced him as governor?
masteryZone.sol: लोपो सोरेस डी अल्बेरिया.

masteryZone.q:
अभिकथन (A): अल्बुकर्क granted विजयनगर a monopoly on the horse trade.
कारण (R): He wanted to strengthen विजयनगर so they could crush the Bijapur Sultanate and secure the Portuguese base at गोवा.
masteryZone.sol: Strengthening विजयनगर served as a counterweight against Bijapur, protecting गोवा from land attacks.
opts: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true

masteryZone.q:
अभिकथन (A): लोपो सोरेस डी अल्बेरिया was appointed Governor of India in 1515.
कारण (R): राजा मैनुअल प्रथम was highly pleased with अल्बुकर्क's independent actions and wanted to reward him with a rest.
masteryZone.sol: Albergaria was appointed, but the King did it out of suspicion and intrigue, not as a reward.
opts: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true

masteryZone.q:
अभिकथन (A): अल्बुकर्क died at sea near गोवा in December 1515.
कारण (R): He was returning from his successful campaign in होर्मुज when he received the news of his replacement.
masteryZone.sol: The shock of his dismissal combined with his existing illness led to his death off गोवा's harbor.
opts: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true

masteryZone.q:
अभिकथन (A): The local Hindu population of गोवा mourned the death of अल्बुकर्क.
कारण (R): He had protected them from Muslim tax rates and banned सती, earning their respect.
masteryZone.sol: His administrative reforms and justice made him a respected figure among local Hindus.
opts: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true

masteryZone.q:
अभिकथन (A): The कार्तज (Cartaz) system allowed free trade for all nations without paying taxes.
कारण (R): अल्बुकर्क wanted to encourage open market competition in the Indian Ocean.
masteryZone.sol: Both statements are false; the कार्तज (Cartaz) system was a restrictive monopoly system that forced all ships to pay taxes and buy licenses.
opts: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true

masteryZone.q:
अभिकथन (A): The Portuguese built their first Indian factory in Bhatkal.
कारण (R): Bhatkal was a major port of the विजयनगर Empire.
masteryZone.sol: Their first factory was built in कोचीन (or Calicut temporarily), but Bhatkal was indeed a major विजयनगर port where they built a later factory.
opts: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true

masteryZone.q:
अभिकथन (A): राजा मैनुअल प्रथम was suspicious of अल्बुकर्क's expansionist policies.
कारण (R): Court nobles in Lisbon feared अल्बुकर्क would declare independence in India.
masteryZone.sol: The King's suspicion was directly fed by the intrigues of court nobles who feared अल्बुकर्क's growing power.
opts: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true

masteryZone.q:
अभिकथन (A): अल्बुकर्क was buried in the Church of Nossa Senhora da Serra.
कारण (R): He was a devout Catholic who built this church in गोवा himself.
masteryZone.sol: He built the church and chose it as his burial place, reflecting his religious commitment and connection to गोवा.
opts: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true

masteryZone.q:
निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें: the विजयनगर alliance:
1. The treaty was negotiated between अल्बुकर्क and Emperor कृष्ण देव राय.
2. The Portuguese secured the right to construct a factory at Bhatkal.
उपरोक्त कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?
masteryZone.sol: Both statements are correct. The alliance was a key diplomatic achievement for both sides.

masteryZone.q:
निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें: the dismissal of अल्बुकर्क:
1. He was replaced by लोपो सोरेस डी अल्बेरिया.
2. He learned of his dismissal while returning from होर्मुज to गोवा.
उपरोक्त कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?
masteryZone.sol: Both statements are correct. He died shortly after receiving the news off गोवा.

masteryZone.q:
With reference to the death of अल्बुकर्क, consider the following statements:
1. He was buried in the Church of Bom Jesus in गोवा.
2. His remains were later transferred to Lisbon in 1566.
उपरोक्त कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?
masteryZone.sol: Statement 1 is incorrect because he was buried in Nossa Senhora da Serra, not Bom Jesus. Statement 2 is correct.

masteryZone.q:
निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें: the कार्तज (Cartaz) system:
1. It required all merchant vessels to carry a pass signed by Portuguese authorities.
2. Vessels carrying a कार्तज (Cartaz) were allowed to trade in spices freely without any restrictions.
उपरोक्त कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?
masteryZone.sol: Statement 1 is correct. Statement 2 is incorrect because even with a कार्तज (Cartaz), ships were prohibited from trading in spices, which remained a Portuguese Crown monopoly.

masteryZone.q:
निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें: the legacy of अल्बुकर्क:
1. He is regarded as the first Viceroy of Portuguese India.
2. He is regarded as the real founder of the Portuguese power in the East.
उपरोक्त कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?
masteryZone.sol: Statement 1 is incorrect because अल्मेडा was the first Viceroy. Statement 2 is correct.

masteryZone.q: Why did the विजयनगर Empire enter into a treaty with the Portuguese?
masteryZone.sol: विजयनगर wanted to secure a monopoly over the imports of war horses from Arabia and Persia to strengthen its cavalry against the hostile Deccan Sultanates, and to prevent Bijapur from acquiring these military assets.

masteryZone.q: Why was अल्बुकर्क dismissed by राजा मैनुअल प्रथम despite his massive conquests?
masteryZone.sol: The King was influenced by अल्बुकर्क's rivals at court, who accused him of acting with too much autonomy and plotting to establish an independent kingdom in India, making the King suspicious of his loyalty.

masteryZone.q: Why did the local Hindu population respect and mourn अल्बुकर्क after his death?
masteryZone.sol: He had provided them with administrative justice, reduced their agricultural taxes compared to Bijapuri rule, protected their village councils, and banned the practice of सती, which protected their widows.

masteryZone.q: How did the कार्तज (Cartaz) system allow the Portuguese to dominate Indian Ocean trade?
masteryZone.sol: It forced all non-Portuguese ships to purchase licenses, pay customs duties at Portuguese ports, and prohibited them from trading in monopolized goods like spices, under threat of confiscation or attack.

masteryZone.q: How did the diplomatic alliance with विजयनगर protect the Portuguese base in गोवा?
masteryZone.sol: By allying with the powerful विजयनगर Empire, अल्बुकर्क secured a land buffer that kept the Sultanate of Bijapur on the defensive, preventing them from launching a full land siege of गोवा.

masteryZone.q: How did अल्बुकर्क's death mark a transition in the governance of the Estado da Índia?
masteryZone.sol: It ended the era of rapid strategic expansion under a single visionary commander, leading to a consolidation phase managed by less autonomous, court-appointed governors.

masteryZone.q: Case Study: The Portuguese-विजयनगर Alliance.
masteryZone.sol: Examine the political, military, and economic alignment of interests between the Portuguese at गोवा and the विजयनगर Empire under कृष्ण देव राय.

masteryZone.q: Case Study: The कार्तज (Cartaz) System and Maritime Monopolies.
masteryZone.sol: Analyze the legal, military, and financial structures used by the Portuguese to enforce and collect revenues from Indian Ocean shipping.

masteryZone.q: Case Study: The Fall of the Visionary Governor.
masteryZone.sol: Investigate how court politics, communication delays, and the King's suspicion cut short the career of Portugal's greatest Eastern commander.

masteryZone.q: Teach the Concept: Trade Monopolies and Resource Control.
masteryZone.sol: Explain how controlling a single critical resource (like cavalry horses or spices) can be used to control regional politics and trade networks.

masteryZone.q: Teach the Concept: Court Intrigue and Colonial Administration.
masteryZone.sol: Discuss how domestic political struggles in the metropolitan center (Lisbon) impact the governance and command of distant colonies.

masteryZone.q: Teach the Concept: Imperial Legacy and Local Memory.
masteryZone.sol: Explain how colonial administrators can be remembered differently by the home country, the local population, and subsequent historians.

practiceQuestions.q:
With reference to the capture of गोवा in 1510, consider the following statements:
1. It was first captured in February 1510 and permanently retaken in November 1510.
2. The Portuguese were assisted by the local Hindu privateer टिमोजा.
3. The captured territory was initially under the control of the Sultan of Gujarat. (संदर्भ: P_ST_1)
practiceQuestions.sol: गोवा was captured from the Sultan of Bijapur (यूसुफ आदिल शाह), not Gujarat. Statements 1 and 2 are correct.

practiceQuestions.q:
निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें: the Portuguese intermarriage policy:
1. It was introduced by Governor Francisco de अल्मेडा.
2. The married settlers were known as कासाडोस.
3. Land grants and tax exemptions were provided to encourage these marriages. (संदर्भ: P_ST_2)
practiceQuestions.sol: The policy was introduced by अल्बुकर्क, not अल्मेडा. Statements 2 and 3 are correct.

practiceQuestions.q:
निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें: the strategic chokepoint of मलक्का:
1. It was captured by अल्बुकर्क in August 1511.
2. The Portuguese built a stone fortress named A Famosa to protect it.
3. The capture of मलक्का cut off direct access to the Spice Islands. (संदर्भ: P_ST_3)
practiceQuestions.sol: It gave direct access to the Spice Islands rather than cutting it off. Statements 1 and 2 are correct.

practiceQuestions.q:
With reference to अल्बुकर्क's religious policies in गोवा, consider the following statements:
1. He completely banned the practice of सती.
2. He forced the entire Hindu population to convert to Christianity.
3. He preserved the traditional village councils (gauncars) for tax collection. (संदर्भ: P_ST_4)
practiceQuestions.sol: He did not force the entire Hindu population to convert; conversion was required only for local brides of Portuguese settlers. Statements 1 and 3 are correct.

practiceQuestions.q:
निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें: the Portuguese-विजयनगर alliance:
1. Emperor कृष्ण देव राय negotiated the alliance with अल्बुकर्क.
2. The Portuguese granted विजयनगर a monopoly over the horse trade.
3. The treaty permitted the Portuguese to build a factory at Bhatkal. (संदर्भ: P_ST_5)
practiceQuestions.sol: All three statements are correct. The alliance was based on mutual hostility toward Bijapur.

practiceQuestions.q:
निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें: the dismissal of अल्बुकर्क in 1515:
1. राजा मैनुअल प्रथम replaced him with लोपो सोरेस डी अल्बेरिया.
2. अल्बुकर्क died in Lisbon shortly after his return.
3. His dismissal was fueled by court rivals who accused him of seeking independence. (संदर्भ: P_ST_6)
practiceQuestions.sol: He died at sea off गोवा, not in Lisbon. Statements 1 and 3 are correct.

practiceQuestions.q:
With reference to the कार्तज (Cartaz) system, consider the following statements:
1. It was a trade license system introduced to monopolize maritime trade.
2. Ships carrying a कार्तज (Cartaz) were allowed to trade in spices freely.
3. It was enforced through the strategic fortresses of गोवा, मलक्का, and होर्मुज. (संदर्भ: P_ST_7)
practiceQuestions.sol: Ships carrying a कार्तज (Cartaz) were still prohibited from trading in spices, which was a Crown monopoly. Statements 1 and 3 are correct.

practiceQuestions.q:
निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें: the administrative structures of early Portuguese India:
1. Scribes and factors reported directly to the Casa da Índia in Lisbon.
2. The Governor held absolute unchecked control over all trade revenues.
3. The gauncar system was kept intact to collect land revenue. (संदर्भ: P_ST_8)
practiceQuestions.sol: The Governor's financial power was checked by factors who reported directly to Lisbon. Statements 1 and 3 are correct.

practiceQuestions.q:
निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें: the battle of Diu (1509):
1. It was fought by Afonso de अल्बुकर्क as Governor.
2. It defeated a joint fleet of Gujarat, Calicut, and Mamluk Egypt.
3. It established Portuguese naval supremacy in the Arabian Sea. (संदर्भ: P_ST_9)
practiceQuestions.sol: The Battle of Diu was fought by Francisco de अल्मेडा before अल्बुकर्क took office. Statements 2 and 3 are correct.

practiceQuestions.q:
With reference to the siege of अदन in 1513, consider the following statements:
1. अल्बुकर्क successfully captured अदन and fortified it.
2. The siege failed due to strong walls and a lack of proper scaling ladders.
3. The failure left the Red Sea spice route partially open. (संदर्भ: P_ST_10)
practiceQuestions.sol: अल्बुकर्क failed to capture अदन. Statements 2 and 3 are correct.

practiceQuestions.q:
निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें: the regional rivals of the Portuguese in 1510:
1. The Zamorin of Calicut was a constant naval opponent.
2. यूसुफ आदिल शाह of Bijapur counter-attacked and temporarily retook गोवा.
3. The Mughal Emperor Babur sent troops to assist Bijapur in गोवा. (संदर्भ: P_ST_11)
practiceQuestions.sol: The Mughal Empire was not yet established (Babur invaded in 1526). Statements 1 and 2 are correct.

practiceQuestions.q:
निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें: the local auxiliary troops in Portuguese service:
1. They were known as लश्कर (Lascars).
2. They were recruited from local Indian populations.
3. They were commanded exclusively by native Indian generals. (संदर्भ: P_ST_12)
practiceQuestions.sol: They were commanded by Portuguese officers, not native generals. Statements 1 and 2 are correct.

practiceQuestions.q:
With reference to the island of होर्मुज, consider the following statements:
1. It was captured by अल्बुकर्क in 1515.
2. It controlled the entrance of the Persian Gulf.
3. The local ruler became a vassal paying annual tribute to Portugal. (संदर्भ: P_ST_13)
practiceQuestions.sol: All three statements are correct. होर्मुज completed the western blockade.

practiceQuestions.q:
निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें: the transition of power in कोचीन (1509):
1. अल्मेडा imprisoned अल्बुकर्क in फोर्ट मैनुअल to delay succession.
2. मार्शल फर्नांडो कौटिन्हो arrived to enforce the King's commands.
3. अल्बुकर्क was released and took office in November 1509. (संदर्भ: P_ST_14)
practiceQuestions.sol: All three statements are correct. Coutinho's arrival resolved the crisis.

practiceQuestions.q:
निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें: the practice of सती in गोवा:
1. It was banned by अल्बुकर्क in 1510.
2. It was the first European prohibition of सती in India.
3. The ban was later repealed by लोपो सोरेस डी अल्बेरिया. (संदर्भ: P_ST_15)
practiceQuestions.sol: The ban was not repealed; it remained in place. Statements 1 and 2 are correct.

practiceQuestions.q:
With reference to the Portuguese trade factory system, consider the following statements:
1. A factory (feitoria) served as a fortified warehouse and trade post.
2. The first Portuguese factory in India was established at गोवा in 1500.
3. Factories were managed by factors (feitores) appointed by the Crown. (संदर्भ: P_ST_16)
practiceQuestions.sol: The first factory was established at Calicut/कोचीन, not गोवा (captured in 1510). Statements 1 and 3 are correct.

practiceQuestions.q:
निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें: the demographic situation of Portugal in the 16th century:
1. Portugal had a total population of approximately 10 million.
2. The small population size limited the number of soldiers that could be sent to India.
3. Intermarriage was used as a strategic solution to build a local loyal population. (संदर्भ: P_ST_17)
practiceQuestions.sol: Portugal's population was only about 1 million, not 10 million. Statements 2 and 3 are correct.

practiceQuestions.q:
निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें: the tomb of अल्बुकर्क:
1. He was originally buried in the Church of Nossa Senhora da Serra in गोवा.
2. His remains were later transferred to Lisbon in 1566.
3. His tomb was respected and visited by local Hindus seeking justice. (संदर्भ: P_ST_18)
practiceQuestions.sol: All three statements are correct. He was highly respected by local populations.

practiceQuestions.q:
With reference to the military assets in South India, consider the following statements:
1. Cavalry war horses were the most critical military asset for regional rulers.
2. The Deccan Sultanates had direct land access to horse breeding grounds in Arabia.
3. The Portuguese controlled the horse imports by capturing गोवा and होर्मुज. (संदर्भ: P_ST_19)
practiceQuestions.sol: Deccan Sultanates had to import horses by sea, as land routes were long and blocked. Statements 1 and 3 are correct.

practiceQuestions.q:
निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें: the Portuguese मार्शल फर्नांडो कौटिन्हो:
1. He was sent with direct orders to enforce अल्बुकर्क's governorship.
2. He was killed during a rash assault on Calicut in early 1510.
3. His death left अल्बुकर्क with undivided supreme command in India. (संदर्भ: P_ST_20)
practiceQuestions.sol: All three statements are correct. Coutinho's death cleared administrative overlapping.

practiceQuestions.q:
निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें: the town of Bhatkal:
1. It was a key port under the विजयनगर Empire.
2. The Portuguese were allowed to build a factory there under the 1510s treaty.
3. It served as the main capital of the Portuguese Eastern Empire. (संदर्भ: P_ST_21)
practiceQuestions.sol: कोचीन and later गोवा served as the capital; Bhatkal was only a factory site. Statements 1 and 2 are correct.

practiceQuestions.q:
With reference to the Battle of Chaul (1508), consider the following statements:
1. The Portuguese fleet was defeated by a joint Gujarati-Mamluk fleet.
2. Lourenço de अल्मेडा, the Viceroy's son, was killed in this battle.
3. अल्बुकर्क commanded the Portuguese forces at Chaul. (संदर्भ: P_ST_22)
practiceQuestions.sol: अल्बुकर्क did not command at Chaul; Lourenço commanded. Statements 1 and 2 are correct.

practiceQuestions.q:
निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें: the strategic chokepoint of अदन:
1. It controlled the entrance to the Red Sea.
2. अल्बुकर्क successfully captured it in 1513.
3. The failure at अदन allowed Egypt and Venice to continue spice trade. (संदर्भ: P_ST_23)
practiceQuestions.sol: अल्बुकर्क failed to capture अदन in 1513. Statements 1 and 3 are correct.

practiceQuestions.q:
निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें: the gauncar system:
1. It was an ancient system of cooperative village land administration in गोवा.
2. The Portuguese kept it intact to ensure agricultural tax collection.
3. Gauncars were replaced by Portuguese nobles immediately in 1511. (संदर्भ: P_ST_24)
practiceQuestions.sol: They were not replaced; the system was preserved. Statements 1 and 2 are correct.

practiceQuestions.q:
With reference to लोपो सोरेस डी अल्बेरिया, consider the following statements:
1. He was अल्बुकर्क's successor as Governor of India in 1515.
2. He was a close ally of अल्बुकर्क who continued his exact strategies.
3. He was appointed by राजा मैनुअल प्रथम due to court intrigues in Lisbon. (संदर्भ: P_ST_25)
practiceQuestions.sol: He was अल्बुकर्क's bitter rival, not an ally. Statements 1 and 3 are correct.

practiceQuestions.q: ऐतिहासिक मदों का सही मिलान करें (संदर्भ: P_M_1):
practiceQuestions.sol: गोवा is the cavalry port, मलक्का is the spice strait, and होर्मुज is the Persian Gulf blockade.

practiceQuestions.q: ऐतिहासिक मदों का सही मिलान करें (संदर्भ: P_M_2):
practiceQuestions.sol: टिमोजा was the guide, कृष्ण देव राय was the ally, and यूसुफ आदिल शाह was the opponent.

practiceQuestions.q: ऐतिहासिक मदों का सही मिलान करें (संदर्भ: P_M_3):
practiceQuestions.sol: कासाडोस were married settlers, Reinois were home-born soldiers, and लश्कर (Lascars) were native auxiliaries.

practiceQuestions.q: ऐतिहासिक मदों का सही मिलान करें (संदर्भ: P_M_4):
practiceQuestions.sol: फोर्ट मैनुअल in कोचीन was the prison, फोर्ट ए फामोसा was in मलक्का, and Nossa Senhora da Serra was the burial church in गोवा.

practiceQuestions.q: ऐतिहासिक मदों का सही मिलान करें (संदर्भ: P_M_5):
practiceQuestions.sol: गोवा in 1510, मलक्का in 1511, होर्मुज/Death in 1515.

practiceQuestions.q: ऐतिहासिक मदों का सही मिलान करें (संदर्भ: P_M_6):

items.left: नीले पानी की नीति (ब्लू वाटर पॉलिसी)

practiceQuestions.sol: Blue water is अल्मेडा's policy, Fortress system is अल्बुकर्क's, and कार्तज (Cartaz) is the licensing pass.

practiceQuestions.q: ऐतिहासिक मदों का सही मिलान करें (संदर्भ: P_M_7):
practiceQuestions.sol: Coutinho was killed in Calicut, अल्मेडा was the first Viceroy, and Albergaria was the successor.

practiceQuestions.q: ऐतिहासिक मदों का सही मिलान करें (संदर्भ: P_M_8):
practiceQuestions.sol: अदन was the failed siege, Bhatkal was the factory site, and Socotra was the island base.

practiceQuestions.q: ऐतिहासिक मदों का सही मिलान करें (संदर्भ: P_M_9):
practiceQuestions.sol: सती ban in 1510, Gauncars were preserved, and कोचीन was the leased base.

practiceQuestions.q: ऐतिहासिक मदों का सही मिलान करें (संदर्भ: P_M_10):
practiceQuestions.sol: Manuel I was the Portuguese King, Mahmud Shah was the मलक्का Sultan, and Ismail Adil Shah was the Bijapur Sultan after 1510.

practiceQuestions.q: ऐतिहासिक मदों का सही मिलान करें (संदर्भ: P_M_11):
practiceQuestions.sol: Lourenço died at Chaul, टिमोजा was from Honavar, and Coutinho was the Marshal.

practiceQuestions.q: ऐतिहासिक मदों का सही मिलान करें (संदर्भ: P_M_12):
practiceQuestions.sol: Moluccas are the Spice Islands, Persian Gulf was controlled via होर्मुज, and Red Sea blockade failed due to अदन.

practiceQuestions.q: ऐतिहासिक मदों का सही मिलान करें (संदर्भ: P_M_13):
practiceQuestions.sol: Casa da Índia was in Lisbon, Estado da Índia was the government, and Feitoria was the trading warehouse.

practiceQuestions.q: ऐतिहासिक मदों का सही मिलान करें (संदर्भ: P_M_14):
practiceQuestions.sol: First entry in February, retreat in May, permanent recapture in November.

practiceQuestions.q: ऐतिहासिक मदों का सही मिलान करें (संदर्भ: P_M_15):
practiceQuestions.sol: Bentinck's ban was 1829, अल्बुकर्क's was 1510, and Akbar discouraged सती without a formal ban.

practiceQuestions.q:
अभिकथन (A): अल्बुकर्क is regarded as the real founder of the Portuguese Empire in the East.
कारण (R): He shifted the strategic focus from अल्मेडा's नीले पानी की नीति (ब्लू वाटर पॉलिसी) to permanent territorial acquisitions. (संदर्भ: P_AR_1)
opts: A और R दोनों सही हैं और R, A की सही व्याख्या करता है
A और R दोनों सही हैं लेकिन R, A की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है
A सही है लेकिन R गलत है
A गलत है लेकिन R सही है
practiceQuestions.sol: अल्बुकर्क's territorial acquisitions like गोवा and मलक्का established a sovereign base, making him the real founder.

practiceQuestions.q:
अभिकथन (A): The Portuguese intermarriage policy was successfully implemented in गोवा.
कारण (R): The Portuguese Crown provided land grants and tax exemptions to soldiers who married local converted women. (संदर्भ: P_AR_2)
opts: A और R दोनों सही हैं और R, A की सही व्याख्या करता है
A और R दोनों सही हैं लेकिन R, A की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है
A सही है लेकिन R गलत है
A गलत है लेकिन R सही है
practiceQuestions.sol: Financial and land incentives successfully encouraged soldiers to settle in गोवा.

practiceQuestions.q:
अभिकथन (A): अल्बुकर्क failed to blockade the Red Sea spice route.
कारण (R): The Portuguese attack on अदन in 1513 was repulsed by local forces. (संदर्भ: P_AR_3)
opts: A और R दोनों सही हैं और R, A की सही व्याख्या करता है
A और R दोनों सही हैं लेकिन R, A की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है
A सही है लेकिन R गलत है
A गलत है लेकिन R सही है
practiceQuestions.sol: The failure to capture अदन meant the Bab-el-Mandeb chokepoint could not be secured, leaving the route partially open.

practiceQuestions.q:
अभिकथन (A): सती was prohibited in गोवा immediately after the conquest in 1510.
कारण (R): सती was a major source of revenue for the Hindu temple administrations in गोवा. (संदर्भ: P_AR_4)
opts: A और R दोनों सही हैं और R, A की सही व्याख्या करता है
A और R दोनों सही हैं लेकिन R, A की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है
A सही है लेकिन R गलत है
A गलत है लेकिन R सही है
practiceQuestions.sol: Assertion is true. Reason is false; सती was banned on moral and settlement policy grounds, not revenue grounds.

practiceQuestions.q:
अभिकथन (A): Emperor कृष्ण देव राय of विजयनगर allied with अल्बुकर्क.
कारण (R): कृष्ण देव राय wanted to secure a monopoly on horse imports to strengthen his cavalry against Bijapur. (संदर्भ: P_AR_5)
opts: A और R दोनों सही हैं और R, A की सही व्याख्या करता है
A और R दोनों सही हैं लेकिन R, A की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है
A सही है लेकिन R गलत है
A गलत है लेकिन R सही है
practiceQuestions.sol: The war horse trade monopoly was a major strategic incentive for विजयनगर to support the Portuguese.

practiceQuestions.q:
अभिकथन (A): अल्बुकर्क massacred the Muslim population of गोवा after recapturing it in November 1510.
कारण (R): He wanted to eliminate any local loyalists who could assist the Sultan of Bijapur in a counter-attack. (संदर्भ: P_AR_6)
opts: A और R दोनों सही हैं और R, A की सही व्याख्या करता है
A और R दोनों सही हैं लेकिन R, A की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है

A गलत है लेकिन R सही है
practiceQuestions.sol: The massacre was a ruthless security measure to prevent internal rebellion by Bijapur supporters.

practiceQuestions.q:
अभिकथन (A): Scribes and factors in India reported directly to the Portuguese Crown in Lisbon.
कारण (R): The Portuguese Crown wanted to prevent the Governor from gaining unchecked financial and administrative autonomy. (संदर्भ: P_AR_7)
opts: A और R दोनों सही हैं और R, A की सही व्याख्या करता है
A और R दोनों सही हैं लेकिन R, A की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है
A सही है लेकिन R गलत है
A गलत है लेकिन R सही है
practiceQuestions.sol: Direct reporting to the Casa da Índia checked the Governor's powers.

practiceQuestions.q:
अभिकथन (A): अल्बुकर्क died off the coast of गोवा in December 1515.
कारण (R): He was returning from Lisbon after defending himself against charges of treason. (संदर्भ: P_AR_8)
opts: A और R दोनों सही हैं और R, A की सही व्याख्या करता है
A और R दोनों सही हैं लेकिन R, A की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है
A सही है लेकिन R गलत है
A गलत है लेकिन R सही है
practiceQuestions.sol: Assertion is true. Reason is false; he was returning from होर्मुज, not Lisbon, when he died.

practiceQuestions.q:
अभिकथन (A): The traditional village councils (gauncars) were preserved by the Portuguese.
कारण (R): The Portuguese lacked the administrative staff to manage revenue collection at the village level. (संदर्भ: P_AR_9)
opts: A और R दोनों सही हैं और R, A की सही व्याख्या करता है
A और R दोनों सही हैं लेकिन R, A की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है
A सही है लेकिन R गलत है
A गलत है लेकिन R सही है
practiceQuestions.sol: Preserving local structures resolved their manpower and administrative deficits.

practiceQuestions.q:
अभिकथन (A): Francisco de अल्मेडा imprisoned अल्बुकर्क in कोचीन in 1508.
कारण (R): अल्मेडा wanted to delay the handover of power and conclude his campaigns himself. (संदर्भ: P_AR_10)
opts: A और R दोनों सही हैं और R, A की सही व्याख्या करता है
A और R दोनों सही हैं लेकिन R, A की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है
A सही है लेकिन R गलत है
A गलत है लेकिन R सही है
practiceQuestions.sol: अल्मेडा was grieving his son's death and disputed अल्बुकर्क's patents to delay the transfer.

mockTestQuestions.q: प्रारंभिक पुर्तगाली भारत में 'कासाडोस' (Casados) का वर्णन निम्नलिखित में से कौन करता है? (मॉक Q1)
opts: पुर्तगाली सैनिक जिन्होंने स्थानीय महिलाओं से विवाह किया और जमींदारों के रूप में बस गए
एस्टाडो दा इंडिया द्वारा भर्ती किए गए मूल भारतीय भाड़े के सैनिक
होर्मुज के बंदरगाह पर सीमा शुल्क अधिकारी
mockTestQuestions.sol: कासाडोस विवाहित प्रवासी थे जिन्हें एक वफादार स्थानीय आबादी स्थापित करने के लिए भूमि अनुदान दिया गया था।

mockTestQuestions.q: अफोंसो डी अल्बुकर्क से ठीक पहले भारत के वायसराय कौन थे? (मॉक Q2)
mockTestQuestions.sol: फ्रांसिस्को डी अल्मेडा पहले वायसराय (1505-1509) थे, उनके बाद अफोंसो डी अल्बुकर्क गवर्नर बने।

mockTestQuestions.q: पुर्तगालियों द्वारा किस शहर में पत्थर का किला 'ए फामोसा' (A Famosa) बनाया गया था? (मॉक Q3)

mockTestQuestions.q: 1510 में अल्बुकर्क द्वारा गोवा में सती प्रथा पर प्रतिबंध लगाने का मुख्य कारण क्या था? (मॉक Q5)
